descs.sim_evidence_packet: Write ONE released-result evidence packet and pre-fill the runbook checklist.
descs.sim_jobs: List recent sim jobs (newest first) with their reconciled state and elapsed time. `jobs` are the durable sim-* registry rows; they persist …
descs.sim_results: Collect a simulation job's results — from ANY tool that returned a job_id.
descs.sim_run: Start an FEA solve in a SEPARATE PROCESS and return a job_id immediately.
descs.sim_status: State of a sim job: queued|running|done|failed|cancelled, elapsed, progress.
descs.simulate_motion: Sweep synchronized mate drivers; return sampled body poses and per-frame clash evidence.
descs.sketch3d_add_constraints: Add constraints to a sketch3d and return the narrated solve results.
descs.sketch3d_add_curves: Append curve entities to a sketch3d feature (edit_feature) and report the solve.
descs.sketch3d_as_sweep_guide: Get the exact sweep ref syntax for using this sketch3d as the PATH or a GUIDE.
descs.sketch3d_clear: Erase all entities + constraints from a sketch3d feature (keeps the feature id).
descs.sketch3d_get: Read back a sketch3d feature: authored params + SOLVED geometry + health.
descs.sketch3d_list: List all sketch3d FEATURES in the part document.
descs.sketch3d_new: Create a NEW `sketch3d` FEATURE in the part document and return its feature id.
descs.sketch3d_path_from_points: ONE-CALL routing path: create a sketch3d feature through the given world points.
descs.sketch3d_pipe: ONE-CALL tube/sweep along a sketch3d path: profile placement + sweep, applied.
descs.sketch3d_preview: TEXT description of a sketch3d's SOLVED geometry — the no-vision describe.
descs.sketch3d_ref_vertex: Ground a sketch3d constraint to a specific VERTEX on the built model (T-3DXREF).
descs.sketch3d_sample_at: Sample a POINT + TANGENT on the SOLVED sketch3d path at arc-length fraction t.
descs.sketch3d_section_at: Cross-section the part with a plane whose ORIENTATION follows the path tangent.
descs.sketch_auto_constrain: Stitch a sketch's near-touching endpoints closed by adding coincident constraints — the cheap way to close chains before dimensioning.
descs.sketch_fully_define: Finish a 2D sketch with editable geometric relations and driving dimensions, never fix pins.
descs.sketch_health: The single narrated read of a sketch's constraint state — solve it and get back WHY it is under/over-defined plus an ordered plan to reach …
descs.sketch_preview_text: Full TEXT description of a 2D sketch — entities, constraints, DOF, regions, health.
descs.slice_part: Slice one part, or several parts on one plate, to printer-ready G-code with STOCK PrusaSlicer and prove the result.
descs.slicer_status: Which slicer slice_part will run (PrusaSlicer, subprocess only), or how to install it.
descs.solve_mates: Solve the mate constraints of an ASSEMBLY document (positions its components).
descs.spec_sheet_match: AI-path spec-sheet matching: datasheet text/URL -> parametric model -> VendorPart.
descs.stackup_analyze: 1D tolerance stack-up analysis: worst-case and/or RSS over a dimension chain.
descs.start_capture_session: Start a local photo-capture server. Returns QR code URL + upload instructions.
descs.steering_turning_radius: TURNING RADIUS of a steered vehicle, from its own solved geometry.
descs.stop_capture_session: Stop the capture session and optionally run photogrammetry reconstruction.
descs.struct_analyze: Run member-force and deflection analysis on a structural document.
descs.struct_check: Return preliminary strength and serviceability utilization by member.
descs.struct_estimate: Estimate structural material and installation costs from a dated rate table.
descs.submit_bug_report: File a bug report for the user when something is broken on OUR side.
descs.submit_part_photos: Register the user's real photo FILES and/or submit the measurements you read from them.
descs.suggest_dimension_scheme: Propose which dimensions to drive in a sketch, with process-aware tolerances.
descs.suggest_drawing_dimension_scheme: Propose per-feature drawing dimensions, tolerances and semantic callouts.
descs.sweep_envelope: SWEPT ENVELOPE of a moving mechanism — the volume its parts need to be given.
descs.tap_drill: Return the standard tap drill diameter for a thread designation (aicad.calc/1, contracts/advisor.md §7).
descs.task_list: Publish the LIVE task list shown in the copilot's Task list panel.
descs.topology_capabilities: Read-only. The native topology-optimization capability matrix — call FIRST.
descs.undo: Undo the last edit on the current part.
descs.vendor_login: Open a HEADED browser window so the user can log into a vendor site.
descs.vendor_part_register: Register scraped price/availability for bom_price; import_artifact handles geometry.
descs.vendor_status: Return the login status of all registered vendor source adapters.
descs.vendors_health: Run a canary health check across the vendor source adapters.
descs.verify_battery: Run deterministic checks on one explicit document.
descs.verify_gcode: Deterministically check a G-code file before it goes to a printer.
descs.verify_packet: Check ONE evidence-packet folder for mutual consistency BEFORE citing it.
descs.vessel_size: Size a pressure vessel to ASME VIII-1: shell + head thickness, MAWP, hydrotest, volume and masses.
descs.wait_job: Block until a background job (get_job id) finishes or timeout_s passes — use instead of sleep/poll loops.
descs.wall_thickness: Sample local wall spans by inward normal rays; NOT a structural-wall safety verdict.
descs.workspace_doc_events: Return per-doc event stream entries starting at *since_seq*.
descs.workspace_status: Return the workspace snapshot: project directory, open documents, owners.

activate_configuration.prompt_note: add_configuration does NOT switch the variant in — call this after tailoring it; confirm the switch via the returned body count/volume.

add_balloon.prompt_note: Link item to a drawing_bom row, then anchor a/pos from review_drawing sheet mm; re-review so the leader and balloon do not obscure geometry.

add_chamfer_dimension.prompt_note: Create a semantic chamfer callout from the ledger's distance/angle; use review_drawing sheet-mm anchors and include it in audit_drawing spec coverage.

add_configuration.prompt_note: Creates the variant but never activates it — follow with set_config_override / set_config_suppression, then activate_configuration.

add_datum.prompt_note: Read feature/label points from review_drawing first (sheet mm); declare datums before any add_gdt frame that references them.

add_datum_target.prompt_note: Use for a controlled point/line/area target (not a whole datum feature); read a/pos from review_drawing and reference the target honestly in GD&T.

add_detail_view.prompt_note: cx,cy,radius are the PARENT view's sheet mm — read them from review_drawing; for a cut through the whole part use add_section_view.

add_dimension.prompt_note: Shop drawings should start make_drawing(model_items=False); place each ledger-driven dimension explicitly with tol_type/tol_upper/tol_lower at creation. dtype='note' takes one anchor plus required text='...'.

add_drawing_sheet.prompt_note: Add a controlled sheet to an existing drawing package, then set_active_drawing_sheet before adding its views/tables/annotations.

add_drawing_table.prompt_note: Place kind=bom|revision|holes|notes|cutlist on the active sheet; use auto-population where supported and verify row content plus layout.

add_drawing_view.prompt_note: Add one base/projected view to a make_drawing doc; x/y are sheet mm. Set show_hidden deliberately and use orientation controls only when the canonical directions do not expose the specified feature.

add_features.prompt_note: Batch related ops in ONE call and read the reply's interpreted, per-feature status and changes fields plus its overlap and attachment warnings (floating/overhanging features) before anything else; a heavy op may return {job_id} — poll get_job. Sketches: draw roughly, relations then functional driving dimensions, sketch_fully_define, check_sketch (dof 0, not pinned_only). Automatic definition (default on) runs after explicit intent; opt out with the auto_define=false argument or auto_define:false on feature/params/authoring op. Use origin/axis.h/axis.v refs, construction sketch_convert references, true arcs/slots and symmetric centerlines; never blanket-fix profiles. op rename relabels a FEATURE by id; no op renames the part — name it in new_part(name=…) and its file in save_part(path=…).

add_gdt.prompt_note: Declare add_datum/add_datum_target references first; row2 creates a composite frame and datum/material modifiers must match the ledger. Re-check placement with review_drawing and coverage with audit_drawing.

add_hole_callout.prompt_note: Use instead of a projected tap-drill diameter: specify simple/tapped/counterbore/countersink semantics, full thread, count and THRU/depth from the ledger, then retain its annotation id for audit coverage.

add_ordinate_dimensions.prompt_note: Use a shared datum origin for patterns/locations that must not accumulate chain error; every ordinate value and tolerance must trace to the ledger.

add_section_view.prompt_note: Use axis for a centre cut or plane/offset/depth/multipoint for a specified cut; sections must expose hidden bores, threads, pockets or welds that need controlled annotations.

add_surface_finish.prompt_note: a/pos are sheet mm from review_drawing; ra is a string ("1.6"). One symbol per call — review_drawing again to check placement.

add_weld_symbol.prompt_note: Place the structured weld requirement (type/size/side plus intermittent length/pitch, contour/finish, field/all-around, tail or full penetration) from the ledger; never replace it with a free note.

advise.prompt_note: Match stage to your workflow phase — the default 'assembly' only runs interference; pass run_id to log for dispute/replay.

advisory_dispute.prompt_note: Contest only with concrete evidence; kernel-sourced disputes return waiver_required=true — a human must confirm the waiver.

analyze_stl_geometry.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health. Takes doc_id, not a file path — import_part the mesh first, then call this on the document.

apply_ascii_edits.prompt_note: Preview with dry_run=True; pass grid_json + index_json from the last render_*_ascii reply so cell coords resolve against that raster, not a re-render.

arrange_drawing.prompt_note: Re-lay the sheet (projection third|first, standard scale, paper size) instead of hand-moving views; dimensions and section cuts follow the views.

ask_user.prompt_note: In the desktop chat the batch is a form and the call waits for the user's answers (or their typed reply); unattended runs take `suggested`. Ask open questions HERE in one call, never as prose at the end of a turn.

asm_add_component.prompt_note: Places a FILE — save_part each part first; the FIRST component is fixed by default. Returns the 'k<N>' id that asm_mate refs use.

asm_mate.prompt_note: Standard seat: concentric (shank↔bore) + coincident (head↔plate); each query must resolve to ONE face/edge — narrow with pick/near/count.

assembly_plan_review.prompt_note: Run at PLANNING time, before a large build — it advises subassembly grouping; deep products should be mated subassemblies, not one giant file.

assess_mesh_quality.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health. We are a B-rep kernel, so this reports SOLID topology health, not triangle quality.

audit_drawing.prompt_note: Required release gate after current review_drawing: doc_id is the SOURCE part/assembly and drawing_id its DRAWING doc. When a manufacturing plan exists, pass the unchanged mfg_plan_get(view='audit_spec') result as spec. Export needs verdict=release_ready with missing_critical empty.

bearing_life.prompt_note: Standalone hand-calc — no document needed. Set X/Y when Fa matters (defaults zero the axial term); C must come from a datasheet.

board_from_schematic.prompt_note: One-call layout on the active wired schematic — pass ERC first; read residual_drc honestly, then ecad_run_dfm / ecad_run_pdn.

bom_price.prompt_note: Network-bound per bought line and useless without provider credentials (Nexar/Digi-Key/Mouser) — unpriced lines come back price-unknown, never guessed. Run bom_rollup first.

bom_rollup.prompt_note: Cheap local classification pass — run it before any pricing: made lines go to cam_cost_estimate, bought lines (with MPNs) to bom_price.

box_status.prompt_note: Box.com mirror health: enabled/connected, the connected account, pending spooled projects, and the project's last sync/error. Call before box_sync to diagnose auth or backlog.

box_sync.prompt_note: Uploads the project's saved files to the configured Box.com folder NOW (new/changed only, never downloads). Saves already mirror automatically when Box is enabled — reach for this only when the user asks to push or box_status shows pending/errors.

browse_models.prompt_note: Labelled contact sheets (12 numbered renders each) of a project's CAD files, read from the files without importing: find the right part here before import_part, never unzip/jq. Tile numbers key the text rows; narrow path/pattern (e.g. 'parts/*') for more than 24 models.

browser_profiles.prompt_note: Persistent vendor browser-profile manager. action='list' performs a fresh no-cache login probe for every saved profile and reports only active/expired/unknown; action='refresh' opens the headed human login flow; action='delete' removes that site's local profile and refuses while it is open. Never refresh-loop or delete without the user's request.

buildgraph_plan.prompt_note: Prefer this over dag_plan when the build steps are already known — deterministic, LLM-free; check advisories + interpreted first.

buildgraph_status.prompt_note: Poll with the run_id from buildgraph_plan; an unknown id returns known_run_ids — pick from that list, never invent one.

cad_graph.prompt_note: blast before editing a shared dimension (what breaks downstream), tree for assembly structure; project_dir is the shared working folder.

cad_graph_link.prompt_note: Record a relationship the extractor can't see (e.g. two parts sharing a bore diameter); persisted as origin='ai' in the project overlay.

cad_guide.prompt_note: Call FIRST in any modeling session — 'overview' for the op cheatsheet, a feature name ('hole', 'sweep') for its exact param shape.

cad_skill.prompt_note: Fetches a pack listed in the [SKILLS] catalog by name — the full procedure, not the one-line summary in your role card. Call it BEFORE the first tool of that workflow (cad_skill(name="assembly-merge") before import_part on foreign CAD, cad_skill(name="simulate") before an FEA release run). path="<file>" reads a resource inside the pack.

cam_add_operation.prompt_note: Get geometry from cam_extract first; omit rpm/feed in params to auto-resolve from material+tool. Call cam_generate after adding ops.

cam_add_setup.prompt_note: Needs an active job — cam_new_job first. Stock defaults to a bbox box-offset; pass cam_extract(kind='stock') output for tighter stock.

cam_add_tool.prompt_note: Define tools before ops — cam_add_operation references them by tool_number, and reusing a number replaces. cam_tool_types lists valid types.

cam_audit.prompt_note: Deterministic G-code verify — run after cam_post before shipping; ok=false means errors, but review warnings too. Works job-free via gcode=.

cam_check_feeds_envelope.prompt_note: Range-checks caller-pinned rpm/feed/stepdown against the table envelope; use feeds_speeds when you want the envelope itself.

cam_cost_estimate.prompt_note: Runs cam_simulate internally for cycle time — the doc just needs CAM ops, not a pre-run sim. Unknown material returns ok=false; pass material= to override.

cam_extract.prompt_note: Reads the CURRENT part (build/open one first) unless path= is given. kind='holes' feeds drill geometry, 'stock' feeds cam_add_setup.

cam_generate.prompt_note: Run after all ops are added, before cam_simulate/cam_post — its warnings (e.g. tool too large for a pocket) beat simulation failures.

cam_job_diff.prompt_note: Run before cam_save to review what changed since the last save, or to sanity-check a hand-edited .cam+ against the live job.

cam_job_tree.prompt_note: Cheap state read — use it to recover setup_id / op_id / tool numbers after context loss instead of re-creating the job.

cam_materials.prompt_note: Valid material ids for cam_add_setup and feeds_speeds; the CuttingDB group ids are what the feeds/speeds priors key on.

cam_new_job.prompt_note: Entry point of every CAM workflow — call first; all siblings act on the job it makes current. Then cam_add_tool/setup/op.

cam_op_types.prompt_note: Valid type strings for cam_add_operation; the op type decides which geometry key (regions/contours/points/profile/mesh) it needs.

cam_open.prompt_note: Replaces the active job — cam_save any unsaved work first.

cam_post.prompt_note: Final step once cam_simulate is clean; verify the output with cam_audit before shipping it to a machine.

cam_post_dialects.prompt_note: Static list — one call suffices. Pick the dialect at cam_new_job(post=...) or override it at cam_post.

cam_redo.prompt_note: Re-applies the last undone edit — only meaningful right after cam_undo.

cam_remove_operation.prompt_note: Undoable via cam_undo. Check cam_job_tree for current op_ids before removing.

cam_save.prompt_note: Persists the job tree (not G-code) to .cam+; reopen with cam_open, review changes later with cam_job_diff.

cam_set_stock.prompt_note: from_sim chains setups: cam_simulate setup 1, then reuse its remaining stock as setup 2's stock for a flip/second-side op.

cam_setup_sheet.prompt_note: Operator-facing summary for the machine floor — needs generated toolpaths (cam_generate first) for cut lengths and times.

cam_simulate.prompt_note: Needs generated toolpaths — cam_generate first. Smaller resolution = finer/slower; check_holder only flags when holder geometry is defined.

cam_tool_import.prompt_note: Needs an active CAM job (cam_new_job first); ops reference the returned tool_number. Feeds/speeds come from feeds_speeds(), not the part record.

cam_tool_types.prompt_note: Valid type strings for cam_add_tool, each with the cutting-data class that feeds/speeds auto-resolution uses.

cam_undo.prompt_note: Reverts the last job edit (ops, tools, setups, stock) — not toolpath generation. Prefer cam_update_operation to fix a bad param.

cam_update_operation.prompt_note: Merge-patch — only the keys you pass change. Edits do not regenerate toolpaths; call cam_generate afterwards.

channel_send.prompt_note: Cross-department channel post (org layer must be active); interface_change auto-acks and blocks your stage exit until acked — keep the body under 120 words.

check_feature_overlap.prompt_note: add_features already runs this per batch (overlap_warnings) — call to re-scan the whole tree or a features=[...] subset; bodies → check_interference.

check_geometry_health.prompt_note: Is this solid actually sound? Reports watertight/manifold plus the COUNTS AND SIDS that justify it (free edges, non-manifold edges, shells, solids, sliver faces, orientation). Run it before an expensive FEA mesh, a CAM toolpath or a STEP/STL export. `self_intersection` is a REAL kernel check now (BOPAlgo_CheckerSI, 20 s per-body budget): a body it flags is NOT sound; checked:false + a reason means it could not run. Body-vs-body overlap is still check_interference. `volume_mm3` is null for a body with no solid. repair/fill_holes/fix_normals/fix_winding are REFUSED here: for a body YOUR features made, fix the feature using the sids it just listed; for an IMPORTED body that arrived broken, call heal_body (a recorded ShapeFix repair).

check_interference.prompt_note: Needs 2+ bodies — solve_mates first on an assembly so placements are real; overlap INSIDE one part's features → check_feature_overlap. Read `clear` for the verdict: ok=true only means the check completed, also when bodies clash.

check_metadata.prompt_note: Read this before verify_battery to pick check names and see cost/platform classes — it is the registry of everything the battery can run.

check_sketch.prompt_note: Before consuming a profile require closed, dof == 0, pinned_only == false, no conflicts/skipped constraints. Blanket fix is not design intent; fixed external references are legitimate. Read findings/free variables, add relations then driving dimensions, sketch_fully_define, and re-check.

check_sketch3d.prompt_note: sketch3d twin of check_sketch; a sweep-spine path needn't reach dof 0, but pinned paths survive edits. wires[k] maps to the sweep ref.

check_symmetry.prompt_note: Confirms an intended mirror really is symmetric (deviation_mm3); spell the plane as axis pair ('XY') or normal ('+z') — Z-up datums.

civil_alignment.prompt_note: Supply EXACTLY ONE of pis (+radii/spiral_lengths) or explicit horizontal segments (headings in radians); vertical={pvis:[...]}, stations/elevations in m. Clears stored results. Next: civil_alignment_analyze.

civil_alignment_analyze.prompt_note: kind=profile|design_vs_existing|sight_distance|sections|earthwork; ground kinds need surface_id, sections/earthwork also a template, sight_distance the real design_speed_kmh. Sections/earthwork persist under earthwork for civil_quantities.

civil_buried_pipe_check.prompt_note: inputs={cover_m, od_m, gamma_kn_m3, wheel/contact loads, ring stiffness/EI, E' or soil_class, groundwater, ...} in m/kPa/kN — no truck or soil values are assumed; conduit/network/surface ids sample cover at ONE station. Next: civil_fea_handoff source='buried'.

civil_cost_estimate.prompt_note: Prices the stored qto (no_qto -> run civil_quantities) with a USER price_book of unit/unit_price/currency/source/date; never invent rates — unpriced items are listed, not zeroed.

civil_crs_transform.prompt_note: Stateless horizontal XY(Z) transform between CRS codes/local grids — elevation is passed through unchanged (no vertical datum shift) and the site model is not edited; set the site CRS deliberately with civil_site_edit set_crs.

civil_culvert.prompt_note: HDS-5 headwater for a culvert spec or site structure_id; tailwater_m is depth above the outlet invert (required), flows is one m³/s value or an ascending list for a performance curve. Refused points must not be dropped to make a curve pass.

civil_detention_route.prompt_note: Modified Puls routing: inflow={t_s, q_m3s} or catchment_id+storm, stage_storage [[stage_m, m³]] or surface_id+polygon+stages, explicit outlets; structure_id writes a detention_pond. Check mass balance; downstream gravity screening does not route storage.

civil_export.prompt_note: Writes path in landxml|geojson|geopackage|ifc|epanet|swmm|qto_csv|cost_csv|msproject; epanet/swmm REQUIRE network_id, and the csv/msproject formats need civil_quantities/civil_cost_estimate/civil_schedule first. Review dropped/warning rows.

civil_fea_handoff.prompt_note: Builds a civil_to_fea envelope from stored source='thrust'|'buried' results (kN/kPa -> N/Pa) — it never solves. Pass target_doc_id and face_selector to bind the load, then run run_fea_static.

civil_fire_flow.prompt_note: Give flow_m3s (m³/s) to test a required withdrawal at junction node_id, or omit it to find the residual-limited available flow; initial-state only — it does not prove fire-duration storage.

civil_grade_pad.prompt_note: cut_slope/fill_slope are positive H:V ratios (2 = 2H:1V), pad_elevation m; creates a distinct graded surface (graded_surface_id must differ from surface_id) and stores cut/fill earthwork. Recheck cover/drainage on the graded surface afterwards.

civil_gravity_analyze.prompt_note: Steady HGL/EGL screening of a gravity network: flows={node|conduit id: m³/s}; catchment_peaks=True adds rational peaks (storm intensity/IDF) — never ALSO pass those flows. Pass surface_id for terrain cover; screening only, not final code acceptance.

civil_gravity_design.prompt_note: Supply the real available_diameters (m) and run apply=False first; apply=True writes the sizes and clears results, so rerun civil_gravity_analyze. Larger pipes never fix an adverse slope.

civil_hydrology.prompt_note: kind=rational|scs_runoff|tc|unit_hydrograph|design_storm|runoff_hydrograph|idf; area m², time s, rainfall mm and mm/h, catchment_id fills omitted area/C/CN/Tc. IDF data must come from the user — never invent it; rational gives a peak, not a volume.

civil_import.prompt_note: format=landxml|geojson|geopackage|epanet|swmm|dem_ascii|dem_xyz; converts foreign units to SI and merges into the active site (merge=False replaces; id collisions need options.replace=True). Review dropped fields/provenance — an imported network is not a solved design.

civil_load.prompt_note: Resume a saved civil_site study (model AND stored results) after a reopen instead of rebuilding from chat memory; pass site=<saved name> when the doc holds several sites.

civil_open_channel.prompt_note: Stateless (nothing persisted): kind=normal_depth (n, slope)|critical_depth|standard_step (length_m, control_depth_m)|hydraulic_jump (y1_m)|capacity; shape={shape: circular|rectangular|trapezoidal, diameter|width|height, side_slope}, SI m and m³/s.

civil_pipe_supports.prompt_note: Support spacing on a piping model (paths mm): supply elastic_modulus_gpa, allowable_stress_mpa (available bending budget at temperature) and pipe_density_kg_m3 — none inferred from a material name. Tributary screening, not ASME acceptance; verify with run_fea_static.

civil_piping_couple.prompt_note: Fixed-point couple of a civil water network_id with a real plant piping solve at tie-ins (civil m/m³/s, plant mm, kPa, m³/h); needs steady DDA and liquid piping. Check converged AND per-tie agreement within tol_rel; re-couple after editing either side.

civil_quantities.prompt_note: Run after FINAL edits/checks: measures pipes, structures, trench (needs bedding_depth_m, sample_step_m, width or clearance + physical OD — not nominal ID) and stored earthwork; persists qto for civil_cost_estimate.

civil_requirement_evidence.prompt_note: Maps stored check rows of source_key (water, gravity, buried, ...) to requirement ids; requirement_ids_by_check maps each check name to one id or a list. Edits nothing — attach the evidence with req_update, and a failing row stays failing.

civil_schedule.prompt_note: CPM from user tasks [{id, duration_d, predecessors [{id, type FS|SS|FF|SF, lag_d}]}] linked to model elements for 4D; start_date (ISO) enables msproject export, day returns planned state, not measured progress.

civil_site_edit.prompt_note: Atomic ops=[{op: upsert|remove|set_crs|set_criteria|rename, collection, element|id}] in SI m/m³/s/kPa; any model change clears ALL stored results, so finish edits first and rerun dependent analyses, quantities and cost.

civil_site_new.prompt_note: Start a NEW civil site (a reopened project uses civil_load instead); the CRS must be projected metres — never guess an EPSG code — and pass doc_id or nothing persists. Next: civil_import or civil_site_edit, then civil_surface_build.

civil_site_summary.prompt_note: Read-only check of counts, CRS, validation errors and stored result keys — run it after imports/edits before analyzing; detail=True only when you need full arrays.

civil_surface_analyze.prompt_note: kind=contours (interval)|slope|profile (polyline)|volume (other_surface_id = bottom; positive = fill)|volume_to_elevation|stage_storage (polygon+stages); volume kinds persist under earthwork for civil_quantities.

civil_surface_build.prompt_note: Build/update a TIN from EXACTLY ONE of points (XYZ m, optional breaklines/boundary) or dem_path (ESRI ASCII, dem_stride subsamples); clears stored results. Next: civil_surface_analyze or civil_grade_pad.

civil_thrust_restraint.prompt_note: Fitting thrust in kPa/m/kN (angle_deg degrees); omitted pressure_kpa reads a stored civil_water_solve head at node_id — not surge/test pressure. Give fitting.direction (global unit XYZ) if a thrust FEA handoff follows; bearing_kpa needs fitting.block geometry.

civil_water_solve.prompt_note: Solve a pressurized water network by network_id (head m, summary kPa); check convergence/residuals before reading the failing-first check rows. The stored heads feed civil_thrust_restraint; pass doc_id to persist them.

civil_watershed.prompt_note: D8 delineation from an ASCII DEM at a projected outlet_xy; a NEW catchment needs outlet_node (an existing gravity node). Then set runoff C/CN/Tc via civil_site_edit before civil_hydrology.

close_part.prompt_note: save_part deliverables BEFORE closing — unsaved AI-owned docs return unsaved_changes and stay open; discard=True is for scratch only.

code_check.prompt_note: doc_path must be an aicad.structure/1 JSON doc; post_size/connection_type run standalone without it. Preliminary check — not sealed engineering.

compare_parts.prompt_note: Re-prove any manual rebuild/edit against the reference (doc_a). No alignment is done — a moved copy scores low; degraded:true means the boolean itself failed.

confirm_dimensions.prompt_note: The only way to close fit-critical demands: typed caliper values, not photo reads. Pass run_id so DAG gates never re-ask.

contact_sheet.prompt_note: Same planner 2x2 grid as render_part without a view; pass views=[...] only when you need specific named angles.

convert_face_to_sketch.prompt_note: Creates a NEW sketch on one planar face; to trace into an open sketch use project_into_sketch. Get face sids from describe_part, then extrude/cut/revolve the regions.

council_convene.prompt_note: Convenes a 2-round multi-seat deliberation (build_strategy, spec_review, failure_review, …); stage/tier default from mission context — slow, reserve for genuinely contested calls.

dag_abort.prompt_note: Cancels a gate-paused run (decision=reject); omit run_id to hit this session's latest run. autonomy_default must match dag_run.

dag_approve.prompt_note: The continue-button after dag_run returns interrupted — resumes execution to the next gate; autonomy_default must match dag_run.

dag_plan.prompt_note: LLM planner — verify the returned graph before dag_run; for a known mechanical sequence prefer deterministic buildgraph_plan instead.

dag_replan.prompt_note: Mid-run surgery: spliced nodes need end_condition + a back-edge with retry_budget or validation fails; route via replan_request first.

dag_run.prompt_note: Plan with dag_plan or mission_start first, then omit graph_json to reuse that plan; run_id with no checkpoint yet STARTS a run under that id; interrupted → paused at a gate: dag_approve/dag_abort.

dag_status.prompt_note: Restart-safe topology; gate_pending is TRI-STATE — null means this process never ran it, not that no gate is pending. Use mission_status for the phase narrative.

delegate.prompt_note: The brief must be fully self-contained — the child sees no chat history. Give role + concrete task + acceptance criteria.

describe_assembly.prompt_note: Queries pre-solve world placements, runs a live mate solve, then checks collision-only threshold fit (exact overlap volumes, clearance bounds, no minimum measured gap). Run solve_mates first when placement rows must reflect the solved pose. Inspect fit completeness/failures; zero checked pairs cannot qualify collision-free. For a single solid part use describe_part.

describe_board.prompt_note: Needs an open ECAD doc (ecad_new_schematic / ecad_new_pcb) first; narrates stored ERC/DRC numbers only — it never re-runs the checks.

describe_part.prompt_note: Make this the first read on any part — the returned sids (faces AND edges) are the stable addresses every later hover() / query_geometry / edit call uses. Call it before naming geometry you have not confirmed exists.

describe_project.prompt_note: Pass dag_status()['run'] for live status; a bare brief string is only narrated back — describe_project reports runs, dag_plan creates them.

describe_results.prompt_note: Run a study first (run_fea_static / run_fea_modal / run_cfd_flow) — it narrates persisted results only and never recomputes.

describe_reveng_result.prompt_note: Read `state`, not just match_pct: built+scored=false means the compare degraded, not a zero fit; state=running means poll again later.

describe_scene.prompt_note: Occlusion is not modeled — a hidden face still lists if it faces the camera; confirm true visibility with render_part when vision is available.

describe_sketch.prompt_note: Takes the sketch feature id ('s1'); once the shape is known, check_sketch returns the same DOF verdict in a much smaller payload.

describe_toolpaths.prompt_note: Needs an active CAM job with results — cam_generate + cam_simulate first; audit=False skips the cam_audit summary for a shorter read.

design_audit.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health — solid soundness only. It does NOT check DFM, tolerances or drawings; those are dfm_check, stackup_analyze and review_drawing.

design_recipe.prompt_note: Empty query lists the recipe catalog; a natural-language query returns ordered steps with params and verify hints.

design_review.prompt_note: One-call narrated battery (interference→dfm→layout_coverage); scope with checks=[...]. Machine-readable {scores,findings} twin → verify_battery.

dfm_check.prompt_note: Run before export or slicing; uses the process bound by set_process unless you pass process=. For FDM it measures walls, overhangs, bridges, support (incl. trapped), holes, internal voids, bed adhesion and bed fit (printer=); rows name faces/features to fix.

doc_diff_tool.prompt_note: Both args are full-document JSON STRINGS (e.g. get_part output), not doc_ids; µm-level float noise is suppressed so unchanged rebuilds diff empty.

doc_sketch_contact_sheet.prompt_note: One image of the doc PLUS every in-progress sketch's health — the pre-commit check that catches under-defined sketches before an extrude fails.

draft_analysis.prompt_note: Mold-release check along pull_dir — the SIGN matters (-Z ≠ +Z); flagged faces come back with centroid+area so you know where to add draft.

drawing_bom.prompt_note: Read live assembly item/name/quantity/source rows before add_balloon or a BOM table; preserve item-number linkage instead of retyping a prose list.

duct_size.prompt_note: Equal-friction duct sizing over a parent-linked segment tree (airflow_m3s, length_m, k_fittings); returns standard round or rect sizes, velocity, pressure drops, the critical path and fan_static_pa. A velocity warning means lower friction_pa_per_m (bigger duct) or split the branch, not ignore it.

ecad_add_power.prompt_note: Drop on a pin's world xy (from ecad_place_symbol's pin list) to bond it to the rail wire-free; undriven-power ERC clears only via a port.

ecad_add_zone.prompt_note: Common case: net='GND' with no geometry floods the board outline. The pour is preview-only until ecad_fill_zones — fill before export/DRC.

ecad_airflow_handoff.prompt_note: Minutes-long OpenFOAM CHT — only when convection presets look wrong (enclosure/fan). dry_run=True inspects the case; verify after with ecad_verify_airflow.

ecad_annotate.prompt_note: Use after placement or before BOM/export. Exact dialect: ecad_annotate(scope='all'|'sheet', mode='keep'|'reset', sheet='<sheet-id>'|None, doc_id=''). 'keep' fills unresolved refs; 'reset' renumbers the selected scope. Next: ecad_status to read the assigned refs.

ecad_antenna_analyze.prompt_note: Always returns a closed-form resonance estimate. want_fullwave=True additionally uses openEMS only when installed; otherwise fullwave.skipped is evidence of no full-wave result, not PASS. Frequencies are Hz. Refine n_freq/max_timesteps and check the full-wave block before trusting S11.

ecad_antenna_design.prompt_note: Design first, then validate via ecad_antenna_analyze with the same params. meander_turns only affects ifa/pifa, velocity_factor only monopole; include_geometry=False returns dims only.

ecad_autoplace.prompt_note: Run after ecad_update_from_sch and before routing; deterministic at seed 0. board_from_schematic already includes this step.

ecad_autoroute.prompt_note: Needs a ratsnest — ecad_update_from_sch first. Failed nets are named; give them room or route by hand. ecad_optimize_traces polishes after.

ecad_bom.prompt_note: Schematic BOM writer, not the PCB fabrication ecad_export. Exact dialect: ecad_bom(doc_id='', fmt='csv'|'json', exclude_dnp=True, path=None). path writes the full returned text client-side. Next: ecad_plot for the drawing deliverable.

ecad_bus.prompt_note: Create the named bus polyline. Exact dialect: ecad_bus(name='D[0..7]', points=[[x,y],[x,y],...], doc_id=''); coordinates are schematic mm. Next: ecad_bus_entry for each used member, then ecad_lint_schematic.

ecad_bus_entry.prompt_note: Connect one wire to one expanded bus member. Exact dialect: ecad_bus_entry(x, y, bus='D[0..7]', member='D0', doc_id=''); (x,y) is the bus-side endpoint. Next: ecad_netlist to confirm the member binding; lint catches unresolved entries.

ecad_check_diff_impedance.prompt_note: Both nets must already be routed. To CHANGE geometry toward a target, solve first with ecad_stackup_solve — this only measures.

ecad_check_impedance.prompt_note: Omit net_or_ref to scan all routed nets for controlled-impedance candidates. Same IPC-2141A models ecad_stackup_solve inverts, so solved traces read back on-target.

ecad_delete.prompt_note: Delete a schematic entity by internal id, or a symbol by ref. Exact dialect: ecad_delete(id_or_ref='w3'|'R1', doc_id=''). Use render_schematic_ascii's index rather than guessing ids. Next: read the returned net/ERC delta and re-render.

ecad_design.prompt_note: Front door for a new circuit: plain-English request -> verified schematic + sim, offline via recipes. It becomes the active doc; board_from_schematic is next.

ecad_edit_symbol.prompt_note: Edit in place by ref or symbol id; omitted slots stay unchanged. Exact dialect: ecad_edit_symbol(ref_or_id, value=None, ref=None, footprint=None, dnp=None, in_bom=None, on_board=None, datasheet=None, unit=None, angle=None, mirror=None, x=None, y=None, fields=None, doc_id=''). Next: ecad_status and read the returned pin/net/ERC readback.

ecad_export.prompt_note: Run ecad_fill_zones first so Gerbers carry the true pour. kind='constraints' emits FPGA XDC/LPF — pair with ecad_fpga_check.

ecad_export_kicad.prompt_note: Write a KiCad 7 .kicad_sch artifact. Exact dialect: ecad_export_kicad(path='design.kicad_sch', doc_id=''). The write is client-side and returns confirmed bytes/path. Next: ecad_plot(fmt='pdf') for a human-readable deliverable.

ecad_fill_zones.prompt_note: Required before Gerber export — the post-edit preview fill is coarse and not what ships. Re-run after any copper edit.

ecad_find_part.prompt_note: Always search before placing — never invent a libid/fpid. Feed the exact libid of a hit to ecad_place_symbol.

ecad_fpga_check.prompt_note: Schematic-side (not board) bank/pin checks; pass io= to declare IOSTANDARDs or VCCIO inference is a guess. Export constraints after via ecad_export.

ecad_import_kicad.prompt_note: Import an existing .kicad_sch into the active schematic. Exact dialect: ecad_import_kicad(path, mode='merge'|'replace', doc_id=''). The source path must exist. Next: ecad_annotate, ecad_status, then ecad_lint_schematic.

ecad_junction.prompt_note: Electrically join crossing/T wires at exact world coordinates. Exact dialect: ecad_junction(x, y, doc_id=''). Do not use it for a visual crossing that should remain separate. Next: ecad_netlist to confirm membership.

ecad_label.prompt_note: Same text+scope merges nets — the clean wire-free connect across a sheet (scope='global' crosses sheets). Names feed ERC, netlist, and SPICE probes.

ecad_lint_schematic.prompt_note: Drawing/bus self-check BEFORE ecad_run_erc, which catches electrical faults: symbol overlap, dangling ends, wires through bodies, floating labels, unresolved bus entries, bus labels without member wires, and unnamed buses. Names exact ids/xy/text; next action is fix each finding and rerun lint.

ecad_load_symbol_library.prompt_note: Escape hatch when the native catalog genuinely lacks a part and you were handed a vendor .kicad_sym file. Exact dialect: ecad_load_symbol_library(path). It registers every symbol in the file and reports the added libids. Do NOT reach for this to invent a part you have no file for — use ecad_make_part with a real pinout instead. Next: ecad_symbols to confirm the exact imported libid, then ecad_place_symbol.

ecad_make_board.prompt_note: One-shot sync->route->fill->DRC from the active schematic (pass doc_id when several are open); hostcheck=True folds in the MCU rule pack.

ecad_make_part.prompt_note: Creates a real symbol+footprint from a pinout YOU supply — this is what ecad_find_part routes to when it refuses to substitute a >3-pin part. Requires name + pins (each {number,name,type,side}) + package (chip/soic/qfn/qfp/sot/dip/header/module_castellated) with its pitch/body dims. It will NOT invent a pinout from a part name: no pins means refusal. Pin type must be the exact KiCad enum — 'power'/'vcc'/'gnd' are refused as ambiguous, use power_in or power_out. Then ecad_place_symbol by the returned libid.

ecad_netlist.prompt_note: Compiled connectivity readback. Exact dialect: ecad_netlist(doc_id='', fmt='summary'|'json'|'kicad', path=None). summary is bounded names/counts; json is the full structured netlist; kicad uses the native writer and path writes the full text. Next: ecad_bom and ecad_plot.

ecad_new_pcb.prompt_note: Manual board path: new PCB -> footprints (fpids via ecad_find_part) -> route -> ecad_run_drc. For a schematic-driven board use board_from_schematic instead.

ecad_new_schematic.prompt_note: Becomes the active doc — omit doc_id afterwards. Next moves: ecad_find_part, then ecad_place_symbol with value set.

ecad_no_connect.prompt_note: Mark one intentionally open pin at its exact world xy from the placed pin list. Exact dialect: ecad_no_connect(x, y, doc_id=''). Never use it to hide an unknown connection. Next: ecad_status and confirm that specific pin clears honestly.

ecad_note.prompt_note: Add non-electrical sheet text. Exact dialect: ecad_note(x, y, text, size=1.27, doc_id=''). It does not name or connect a net; use ecad_label for that. Next: ecad_plot to verify the note in the deliverable.

ecad_optimize_traces.prompt_note: Post-route polish: run after autoroute, before fill/DRC. Pass targets={net: ohms} to retune widths; idempotent and DRC-guarded, safe to re-run.

ecad_place_symbol.prompt_note: libid must come from ecad_symbols or ecad_find_part. Set value now ('1k', '5') for simulation, and keep the returned pin xy list — ecad_wire needs it.

ecad_plot.prompt_note: Produce the deliverable vector drawing. Exact dialect: ecad_plot(doc_id='', fmt='svg'|'pdf', path=None, sheet=None, title_block=True). It always writes confirmed artifact path(s); sheet=None plots all sheets. Next: include returned paths/bytes in the handoff.

ecad_route_diff_pair.prompt_note: Routes ONE coupled pair on an already-routed board — use this instead of ecad_autoroute when you only need to add or redo a pair, since autoroute rips up every other net. Exact dialect: ecad_route_diff_pair(net_p, net_n, opts=None), opts keys diff_gap/length_tol/pitch/max_grid_cells/via_cost/bend_cost/min_clearance. Width comes from the net class — there is no width or layer option here. Never assume matching succeeded: read routed, then compare skew_mm against your length_tol and check coupled_pct. Next: ecad_run_drc.

ecad_route_pad_to_pad.prompt_note: Hand-routes the nets ecad_autoroute reported as failed. Needs from_ref/from_pad/to_ref/to_pad. The net is READ off the pads — pads on different nets are refused, never shorted. Width comes from the ecad_stackup_solve net class unless you pass width. Set to_layer to change layer and it inserts a via. Real tracks, so ecad_run_drc sees them.

ecad_run_dfm.prompt_note: Fab-readiness pass once DRC is clean; fix courtyard_overlap first, then drill_min. Advisory — warnings never block editing.

ecad_run_drc.prompt_note: Advisory spacing/size check after routing — the by_rule grouping says widen, move, or re-space. Pair with ecad_run_dfm before export.

ecad_run_erc.prompt_note: Schematic gate before board sync: errors (output shorts, undriven power) are real bugs; warnings are usually unwired pins. Never blocks edits.

ecad_run_hostcheck.prompt_note: Catches board-bricking MCU/FPGA issues DRC can't (decoupling, sequencing, crystal, straps); needs eng metadata — seed via sim_params.eng.

ecad_run_pdn.prompt_note: DC IR-drop on routed copper. Currents come from rail metadata or sink_overrides — unknown draws are reported, never modelled as 0 A.

ecad_run_sicheck.prompt_note: Fires only from ecad_set_net_class declarations — declare match/skew/termination first or nothing runs. Heuristics, not a field solver.

ecad_set_net_class.prompt_note: THE SI-rule declaration path (params merge additively, same schema ecad_stackup_solve writes); ecad_run_sicheck reads these classes.

ecad_simulate.prompt_note: Start with 'op', then tran/ac; omitting probes returns a bounded ~12-node set. ngspice unlocks vendor models but degrades honestly to mna.

ecad_stackup_solve.prompt_note: Solve BEFORE routing so autoroute/DRC inherit solved widths/gaps via net classes; net_map binds existing nets. Works boardless for design-ahead.

ecad_status.prompt_note: First call when unsure — compact counts plus prioritized next_actions. erc_available=false means ERC failed and is NEVER a clean result. Drill down with detail='list'/'full' + include='pins,members' only when wiring.

ecad_sweep.prompt_note: One parameter, explicit values list (no start/stop/step); re-runs the analysis per value — keep the list short on transient runs.

ecad_symbols.prompt_note: Native catalog discovery; use this instead of guessing libids. Exact dialect: ecad_symbols(query='', limit=20), limit 1..100. Results carry exact libid/pin metadata. Next: feed an exact libid to ecad_place_symbol.

ecad_tf.prompt_note: DC gain + Rin + Rout in one shot — the amp gain/loading check. backend='ngspice' only matters for vendor .SUBCKT parts.

ecad_thermal_handoff.prompt_note: Board->thermal FEA in one call; unpowered components get no source (coverage.unpowered_refs). dry_run inspects BCs; ecad_verify_thermal gives the verdict.

ecad_to_3d.prompt_note: Run once the board has an outline; writes STEP plus the boardphys sidecar that thermal/PDN/power_budget consume. Import the STEP for enclosure design.

ecad_update_from_sch.prompt_note: The schematic->board sync: run after ERC-clean wiring, before routing; re-run to re-sync after schematic edits. Sim sources/power symbols skip by design.

ecad_verify_airflow.prompt_note: Follow-up to ecad_airflow_handoff (uses the session's last solves by default); an optimistic preset returns an effective-h to re-run with.

ecad_verify_thermal.prompt_note: Verdict step after ecad_thermal_handoff: Tj vs limits + theta_ja cross-check. The 75% tolerance is deliberate — catches setup blunders, not layout accuracy.

ecad_vibe_check.prompt_note: Screening, not sign-off: default flat PSD is a NAVMAT-class level — pass psd_breakpoints for a spec-true run. dry_run shows mounts/mass model first.

ecad_wire.prompt_note: Pins accept numbers or names from ecad_place_symbol's pin list; confirm the join in the returned net_members. For rails prefer ecad_add_power.

edit_drawing_annotation.prompt_note: Patch/delete by view_id + annotation_id from review_drawing; any mutation invalidates the release sequence, so review_drawing then audit_drawing again.

em_driven.prompt_note: Uniform-guide default is analytic-uniform: ideal matched S21 propagation, not evidence for a discontinuity or antenna. Frequencies are GHz, length is mm. Call em_status before solver='openems'; absent openEMS returns ok:false/skipped. detail=True returns full S-parameter arrays.

em_eigenmode.prompt_note: Requires standard='WR-90' or waveguide JSON {shape,a_mm,b_mm,eps_r?}; default solver is builtin-fdfd. Frequencies are GHz in the result. Refine resolution and require TE10 error_vs_analytic_pct to settle before quoting cutoff; detail=True includes field data.

em_status.prompt_note: Capability probe before requesting full-wave work. builtin-fdfd eigenmode and analytic-uniform driven/time-domain are expected built-ins; inspect solvers/defaults. openEMS installed=false means full-wave is unavailable, never a successful fallback.

em_timedomain.prompt_note: Uniform-guide pulse delay/dispersion, not an S-parameter sweep. length is mm and f0_ghz/bw_ghz are GHz; zero values auto-derive a band. Default is analytic dispersive IFFT. Check em_status before openEMS; detail=True returns waveforms.

enable_tools.prompt_note: Enable only the packs the current step needs — every enabled tool costs prompt tokens for the rest of the turn.

engine_profile.prompt_note: Perf triage for THIS engine process: start → work → stop/report; 'contention' is the multi-agent g_mtx bottleneck the CPU sampler can't see.

engine_profile_tree.prompt_note: Scoped profile read — start at depth=1/top=8, drill with path=... instead of ingesting the whole report; source='phases' needs no start.

export_drawing.prompt_note: Final drawing artifact only: make_drawing → current review_drawing → audit_drawing(verdict=release_ready) → export. Release PDFs with editable siblings in one call via fmt='pdf', companions=['dxf','svg']; use fmt='svg' alone when only an editable illustration is needed. Use sheet='all' for the controlled multi-sheet package; 3D exchange files use export_part.

export_part.prompt_note: fmt='step' is standard machine-shop exchange; fmt='step+' saves the editable native ZIP. Assembly exports resolve nested path-backed children or refuse with the missing component/path; inspect components:[{name,solids,source}]. validated:true means exact B-rep round-trip solid counts; mesh/native saves do not claim that validation.

export_reveng_bundle.prompt_note: Archival/hand-off only — zips the whole session dir (images, mesh, fits); not part of the in-app flow. dest's parent dir is created.

feeds_speeds.prompt_note: Look up the envelope before pinning params in cam_add_operation; pass machine= to clamp to a real machine's rpm/feed limits.

fetch_cad_model.prompt_note: Use for a specific CAD model page or STEP/IGES URL found after checking the parts library and product matches. Returns a sourced artifact and, by default, imports it; with import_part=False pass artifact_path to import_artifact. A page is not dimensional evidence.

fit_calc.prompt_note: Call BEFORE any hole/bore sizing decision; if the fit class is unknown, resolve function first with recommend_fit. A bare diameter alone returns a teaching error naming both modes.

fit_cylinder_axis.prompt_note: Least-squares bore/shaft axis around near=[x,y,z] — the way to find a hub bore or axle on a TESSELLATED import; judge rms_residual_mm against radius_mm before placing anything on the axis (cad_skill(name="assembly-merge")).

fit_report.prompt_note: No args = document report (needs measurements recorded first); explicit bore/shaft args = ad-hoc one-off, same engine as fit_calc.

fs_edit.prompt_note: Copy 'old' verbatim (indentation included) from an fs_read window; an 'ambiguous' error means widen the surrounding context, not retry the same string.

fs_glob.prompt_note: Matches come back newest-first, so recently generated outputs surface at the top; '**' recurses — anchor it under a subdirectory to stay under the scan and 32 KiB response budgets. Budget/deadline refusals are not empty or complete search results.

fs_grep.prompt_note: Python regex, line-oriented, in a killable readonly child with a two-second per-tool deadline. Skips files initially >8 MiB; bounds input to 64 MiB, 5000 files and responses to 32 KiB. A deadline or budget exhaustion is a typed refusal, not partial success; simplify the regex or narrow path+glob/lower max_matches. Follow hits up with fs_read's line selector.

fs_list.prompt_note: Directories only (a file path errors) — orient here first, then fs_glob/fs_grep to go deeper; dirs sort before files; CAD rows carry a one-line card summary.

fs_read.prompt_note: Windowed by design: after a fs_grep hit, jump straight there with a 'path:50-200' selector instead of paging from the top; binary files are refused, directories list entries; a CAD file returns its card plus a labelled render (preview image), not its bytes. Text scans are chunked and bounded to 64 MiB; larger/changing inputs refuse with read_budget_exceeded/file_changed, not a partial success. To parse a large supported file (json.loads), read raw=true from byte_offset=0, follow next_byte_offset while truncated is true, and join the page texts; do not parse a single truncated page.

fs_write.prompt_note: Full overwrite, no append — never use it to patch an existing file; that is fs_edit's job. Parent dirs are created for you.

fw_avr_flash.prompt_note: Flash an AVR target with avrdude — requires hex_path and mcu (programmer='arduino' pairs with the arduino-cli build; leave port empty for USB HID programmers like usbasp). Needs avrdude plus live hardware; without either, fw_emulate_simavr is the honest path.

fw_build.prompt_note: Cross-compile the project to an ELF — requires project_id from fw_new_project; a missing toolchain returns success=false returncode=-1, not an error, so surface the install hint instead of retrying. Then fw_sim_run with the returned elf_path.

fw_debug_gdb_halt.prompt_note: Halt an ARM target through OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg; prefer fw_debug_halt when probe-rs covers the chip. Needs openocd and arm-none-eabi-gdb on PATH plus a live SWD/JTAG probe; then fw_debug_gdb_read_mem or fw_debug_gdb_step.

fw_debug_gdb_read_mem.prompt_note: Read target memory over OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg, address and length, and a halted target (fw_debug_gdb_halt first); output is the raw MI record, NOT decoded hex, so prefer fw_debug_read_mem when probe-rs supports the chip.

fw_debug_gdb_reset.prompt_note: Reset an ARM target via a fresh OpenOCD + gdb/MI session — requires openocd_cfg (halt=True stops at reset). Fallback for chips outside probe-rs's registry; each call re-attaches, so breakpoints do not reliably persist. Needs openocd plus a live probe.

fw_debug_gdb_set_breakpoint.prompt_note: Insert a breakpoint over OpenOCD + gdb/MI — requires openocd_cfg and address, raw addresses only ('0x8000100') because no symbol table is loaded, so 'main' will not resolve. May not survive the next call's fresh attach; continue with fw_debug_gdb_step.

fw_debug_gdb_step.prompt_note: Single-instruction step an ARM target — requires openocd_cfg and a halted target (fw_debug_gdb_halt or a breakpoint hit first); step_over=True steps over calls. Inspect with fw_debug_gdb_read_mem.

fw_debug_halt.prompt_note: Reset-and-halt a target via probe-rs — requires chip (the probe-rs chip id); needs probe-rs on PATH plus a live DAP probe. Inspect with fw_debug_read_mem, resume with fw_debug_start.

fw_debug_read_mem.prompt_note: Read target memory via probe-rs — requires chip, address and length, and a halted target (fw_debug_halt first); returns decoded data_hex, unlike the gdb variant's raw MI record. Needs probe-rs plus a live probe.

fw_debug_start.prompt_note: Reset and run a target via probe-rs — requires chip; the counterpart that resumes after fw_debug_halt/fw_debug_read_mem inspection. Needs probe-rs plus a live DAP probe.

fw_emulate_renode.prompt_note: Run an EXISTING Renode script — requires resc_path (fw_sim_run generates .resc files; hand-author only for what it cannot cover); the scheduled stop after run_s reports success=True. Needs renode on PATH; for a project-driven run use fw_sim_run instead.

fw_emulate_simavr.prompt_note: Emulate or debug an AVR ELF with simavr — requires elf_path and mcu; gdb=True drives avr-gdb through mi_commands (the universal AVR debug path, since modern UPDI debug has no open GDB exposure). Needs simavr on PATH; real silicon is fw_avr_flash.

fw_flash.prompt_note: Flash a built image to real hardware — requires elf_path (probe-rs for an .elf with chip, esptool for an ESP32 .bin when port is given); missing tools return success=false, not errors. Needs probe-rs or esptool plus a connected board; prove the firmware with fw_sim_run first.

fw_new_project.prompt_note: Scaffold the firmware project once and keep its project_id — pass name and mcu_family (toolchain defaults to 'cmake'), plus board_doc_ref to link a PCB so mcu_family comes from the BOM and a pinmap.h of PIN_<NET> defines is generated; it returns root_dir, which is OUTSIDE the fs jail. Then author code with fw_sources(write={...}), never fs_write.

fw_power_profile.prompt_note: Derive an aicad.powerprofile/1 duty-cycle current profile from an EXISTING trace — requires trace_path (the <elf>.trace.json fw_sim_run returned); no live emulation. Bookkeeping, not SPICE; its per-rail schedules feed power_budget and run_fea_thermal transients.

fw_sensor_scenario.prompt_note: Turn a flight/CFD/kinematic profile into emulated sensor stimulus — pass profile (a JSON object string with t_s plus the physical series) and sensor_map [{device, address}]; pure Python, no Renode needed. Feed the returned scenario to fw_sim_run(scenario=...).

fw_serial_close.prompt_note: Release a live serial handle — requires handle from fw_serial_open; an already-closed or unknown handle returns success=false, not an error. Last step of the fw_serial_* monitor loop.

fw_serial_open.prompt_note: Open a raw 8N1 byte pipe to a PHYSICAL device — requires port (baud defaults to 115200); the returned handle is process-local and dies with the host. Then fw_serial_read / fw_serial_write, and always fw_serial_close. Emulator UART is fw_sim_run instead.

fw_serial_read.prompt_note: Non-blocking poll of a live serial handle — requires handle from fw_serial_open; empty data_hex means nothing buffered, not an error, so poll repeatedly and decode the hex yourself. Close with fw_serial_close.

fw_serial_write.prompt_note: Write to a live serial handle — requires handle plus either data_hex (raw bytes) or text (console typing); data_hex wins when both are given. Read the reply with fw_serial_read.

fw_sim_run.prompt_note: Emulate the built firmware and check assertions — requires project_id (plus elf_path/scenario/assertions; run_s is how long the TARGET runs, a floor not a cap, and a longer scenario timeline still extends it, while timeout_s is the wall-clock budget and wins outright; power_profile=True folds in fw_power_profile) and a successful fw_build first; scenarios and gpio assertions are Renode-only, ESP32 is build+flash. An absent emulator is an honest SKIP in uart_log, never a FAIL to invent around; then fw_power_profile on the returned trace_path.

fw_sources.prompt_note: The ONLY way to get firmware code on disk — requires project_id, and author with write={'src/main.c': '<code>'} (never fs_write: the project root is outside the fs jail and fs_write refuses it). write also appends compilable paths to the CMakeLists add_executable() so fw_build compiles them; bare add=['src/x.c'] only stubs an EMPTY file. Use PIN_<NET> constants from pinmap.h, never raw pin numbers. Then fw_build.

fw_status.prompt_note: Firmware provisioning doctor — needs no arguments (a project_id is accepted and ignored) and never fails, offline-safe; read families.*.can_build/can_emulate/can_flash and the install banners before anything else. Call FIRST, then fw_new_project.

fw_verify_board.prompt_note: Pre-fab firmware<->board co-verification — requires board_doc_ref (pass project_id so pin refs come from the sources, sch_doc_ref for drive-clash checks, trace_path or emulate=True for the dynamic pass). Advisory ERC-shaped findings; run after fw_build/fw_sim_run.

gear_check.prompt_note: SF fields stay null until you pass the allowable stresses — supply S_t/S_c for a pass/fail read; take J/I from AGMA 908 charts.

get_job.prompt_note: Poll the job_id a backgrounded heavy call returned (add_features / run_fea_* / run_cfd_flow) — never re-issue the original call.

get_part.prompt_note: summary=True on big/imported docs (elides BREP blobs); the full tree is for round-trip param editing. Both forms: features at result['tree']['features']. Feature ids here feed edits and config overrides.

get_reveng_coverage.prompt_note: Check before reveng_reconstruct: capture the `missing` shot slots first, and always surface `method` — count_proxy is an estimate until a sparse model exists.

get_reveng_deviation.prompt_note: Post-build quality check; ref_path is required (the brep_doc_id lane errors as not-yet-implemented). Bigger n_samples on dense scans.

get_reveng_session.prompt_note: The polling read while a mission runs — session.run mirrors run progress. Find ids with list_reveng_sessions first.

heal_body.prompt_note: The repair check_geometry_health refuses — use it ONLY on a body that arrived broken from an import (bad_orientation_of_subshape, not_closed, free_edge, negative volume). It appends a RECORDED `heal` feature, so never 'repair' geometry with a BREP/STL round-trip or a self-boolean instead. `target` is a feature id/name or a 1-based body number; omit for a single-body part. A bare call runs ShapeFix and clears most imports; when it does not, climb ONE rung per call and read the evidence: sew_tolerance_mm (stored edge sharing is wrong), then fix_orientation:true (flag-only, keeps every surface exactly), then rebuild_solid:true (+unify_faces) which is REQUIRED when the returned orientation.conflicts > 0 — that graph is self-contradictory and no flag repair can satisfy it. Raise tolerance_mm at most one decade at a time; above the part's real feature size it merges geometry and gets REFUSED. A heal that would cost more than max_volume_change_pct (0.5%) of the material FAILS and leaves the body untouched — read material_change_pct and bad_edges_before/after, not just `fixed`. A defect your OWN features caused must be fixed at the feature; healing over it returns on the next parameter edit.

health_check.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health for one body. For the whole-part review battery call design_review; for sketch state, sketch_health.

heatsink_select.prompt_note: Run ecad_thermal_handoff FIRST — this re-solves on its cached mesh, one solve per candidate. Impossible targets name the best achievable, never fake a win.

hover.prompt_note: Feed it a sid from describe_part / query_geometry; hover only the 1-2 entities an edit touches instead of re-reading the whole outline.

hydraulic_add_component.prompt_note: Needs an active circuit (hydraulic_new first). Per-type param keys are in contracts/hydraulic_schema.md; fill sourcing so hydraulic_bom isn't un-sourced.

hydraulic_add_hose.prompt_note: Connects ports by component_id+port from hydraulic_add_component's returned ids; a net takes >=2 connections (pressure/tank/work_a/work_b/drain).

hydraulic_bom.prompt_note: Roll up after components are in; lines without mpn come back flagged un-sourced — the summary lists what still needs sourcing.

hydraulic_fea_handoff.prompt_note: Only builds run_fea_static arg sets — it never solves. Pass fea_args to run_fea_static, then close the chain with hydraulic_verify_fea.

hydraulic_layout_3d.prompt_note: Place circuit components in 3D (mm) for the GUI's Hydraulics > 3D Layout: positions {component_id: [x, y, z]} merge into the saved study's layout3d (doc_id persists it; results are kept). hydraulic_load returns the full layout including defaults.

hydraulic_load.prompt_note: Restore a hydraulic_circuit study (doc_id, optional circuit name) as the active circuit, with its saved sizing/bom/simulate and valve schedule; call it after a reopen instead of rebuilding the circuit from chat memory.

hydraulic_new.prompt_note: First call of the hydraulic workflow — the returned doc becomes the implicit session doc for all later hydraulic_* calls.

hydraulic_piping_handoff.prompt_note: Runs the real piping solve inline and returns the simhandoff envelope — pass load_pressure_bar for the pump margin; verify with hydraulic_verify_piping.

hydraulic_simulate.prompt_note: Transient of the active circuit (or doc / doc_id's saved one): every port wired, required params set, valve_schedule [{t_s, component_id, position a|b|center|0..1}], loads per cylinder/motor. Cite summary (peak_pressure_bar, stroke_time_s, steady_speed_rpm, efficiency) and ratings.exceeded; series are cut to <=400 points — series_path holds full resolution. missing_params/unconnected_port name the fix; pass doc_id to save the run in the hydraulic_circuit study.

hydraulic_size_cylinder.prompt_note: Pure sizing hand-calc, no document needed; rod_mm=0 makes retract=extend. Feed the recommended flow to hydraulic_size_pump next.

hydraulic_size_motor.prompt_note: pressure_bar is the DIFFERENTIAL across the motor (supply minus back pressure). Put the returned standard displacement (result field standard_displacement_cc_rev) on the motor_hydraulic component and feed flow_lpm to hydraulic_size_pump; doc_id saves it under results.sizing.motors.

hydraulic_size_pump.prompt_note: Hand-calc counterpart to hydraulic_size_cylinder; displacement scales inversely with speed_rpm, so set the real motor speed.

hydraulic_templates.prompt_note: Read-only catalog of native circuit templates; pass an entry's id as hydraulic_new(template=..., doc_id=...) to start from a complete circuit and suggested simulation setup instead of adding every component by hand.

hydraulic_verify_fea.prompt_note: Verify node for the hydraulic-to-FEA envelope (defaults to the session's last); fea_result is advisory — the force-magnitude checks gate the verdict.

hydraulic_verify_piping.prompt_note: Verify node for the piping coupling; no args reuses the session's last handoff+solve. Pass supply/load pressures to refresh the pump margin.

import_artifact.prompt_note: Import an acquired CAD artifact_path (from a done scrape job or fetch_cad_model(import_part=False)); afterwards reverse_engineer(source=doc_id) can recover features.

import_part.prompt_note: into=doc_id adds an import feature there; omit for a NEW independent doc (resume=False default), even if the source is open. resume=True explicitly reuses that saved session. Use the returned doc_id and its feature ids. .sldprt prefers the SW tree; mesh → as_solid=True to sew a solid. Multi-body source: describe_part rosters the bodies, keep_bodies/exclude_bodies (ordinals or names) drop the ones you don't want.

import_scan_mesh.prompt_note: Bypasses photogrammetry when a scan mesh already exists; pass scale_mm if known, else calibrate afterwards with reveng_set_scale.

inspect_feature.prompt_note: Planner close-ups (hero/alt/alt2, a section for internal features) + whole-part context of one feature — only when render_part(target=...)'s grid is ambiguous.

inspect_model_integrity.prompt_note: Read-only census of EVERY solid, including disconnected children inside assembly components. Inspect complete, source_failures, pair_failures, isolated_solids and nearest; ok only means the query ran. proximity_mm is a search radius, not approved clearance; a positive gap is not contact. Increase pair_budget_s (maximum60) when exact checks time out, never treat unknown evidence as clean. Geometric islands, overlaps and fixed flags do not establish fastening, mechanical capture or a load path.

inspect_native_files.prompt_note: Inventory .step+ metadata without import/open/compile/solve. Pass absolute project-root paths and a NEW .json output_path for large inventories; full results live there, not in the bounded chat summary. document_hash is native canonical FNV, not SHA256. Unsupported dependencies and failures are evidence, not permission to unzip or hand-edit CAD containers.

inspect_part.prompt_note: Single close-up = render_part(target=..., view="auto") plus framing knobs (zoom_factor, margin, cutaway); same target and view vocabulary.

inspect_section.prompt_note: The cut always passes through the ORIGIN on a reserved plane — returns area/centroid/Ixx/Iyy; an offset cut belongs in a drawing (add_section_view).

intake_status.prompt_note: Cheap orient call before any intake work: bound process, open critical-dim demands, and any pending photo request to resume.

interface_check.prompt_note: Catches hole-pattern/coaxiality misalignment that passes check_interference — solve_mates first, run BOTH; fastener='M6' adds a pass-through check. Read `status` (pass|fail|skip) for the verdict: a misalignment keeps ok=true.

is_watertight.prompt_note: Alias of check_geometry_health (same tool, trimesh's name). Returns the full report, not a bare bool — read `watertight` plus free_edges/non_manifold_edges for why.

layout_plan.prompt_note: Intake-time, BEFORE add_features — records envelope/critical dims/interfaces as requirements so the layout_coverage gate can check them at sign-off.

layout_plan_report.prompt_note: Read back the plan plus verification coverage (verified vs outstanding); the doc must have a layout_plan recorded first.

ledger_events.prompt_note: Raw event stream for the GUI transparency feed — agents almost always want ledger_get instead.

ledger_get.prompt_note: Section names are fuzzy-matched — pass one bare name (decisions, dimensions, …) or omit for the full render; raise budget_tokens for large ledgers.

ledger_note.prompt_note: The run's append-only memory: record every decision/dimension with provenance so later turns never re-derive a number.

list_artifacts.prompt_note: Newest-first artifact registry (reports/decks/workbooks); filter by run_id — an unknown run_id is count:0, not an error.

list_calcs.prompt_note: Discovery for research_eng_calc: call once to learn the registered calc_ids and their input schemas instead of guessing formula names.

list_configurations.prompt_note: See the variants and which is active before editing; build with add_configuration + set_config_override, switch with activate_configuration.

list_drawing_sheets.prompt_note: Inspect sheet ids, names and active state before set_active_drawing_sheet or export_drawing(sheet='all'); never assume the first sheet is the package.

list_parts.prompt_note: Open docs in this session; after a server restart this is empty — recover_parts reloads the autosaved docs (with fresh doc_ids).

list_print_profiles.prompt_note: Resolve the user's printer words to a vendor preset and see layer heights/filaments; pin names via slice_part print_preset/filament_preset.

list_reveng_dims.prompt_note: Read before a dimension gate: rows arrive strongest-evidence-first and `key` is what the confirm ledger expects back. Empty list means nothing measured yet.

list_reveng_sessions.prompt_note: Discovery read — find session_ids and statuses before calling any other reveng_* tool.

list_spec_templates.prompt_note: Call before spec_sheet_match: required keys gate the build and are never defaulted, so the datasheet must yield exactly these dims.

list_standard_parts.prompt_note: Catalog browse for make_standard_part (family keys, sizes, lengths) — standard-before-custom: check here before modeling hardware by hand.

list_tool_categories.prompt_note: List the requestable category packs, then unlock with enable_tools(categories=[...]).

list_world_bodies.prompt_note: World-placed bboxes per body/component — read right after solve_mates to confirm where everything landed; pair with check_interference for fit.

look_around.prompt_note: Tiled close-ups of ONE target (planner set, or ranked=False for an even orbit) — only when render_part(target=...)'s grid leaves the shape ambiguous.

machining_ref_get.prompt_note: Fetch one curated record by stable record_id for its full conditions, units and source citation. Lookup facts are advisory; a delegate_tool record points to the canonical calculator/tool instead of duplicating its values.

machining_ref_index_pdf.prompt_note: Index a user-owned local PDF into the project-local page FTS store; content is never bundled or uploaded. Set project_root when no project is active; scanned pages without extractable text are reported honestly, not OCR-guessed.

machining_ref_search.prompt_note: Search the curated cited machining dataset with optional topic/material/process filters. When a hit returns delegate_tool, call that named canonical tool for the value instead of quoting or copying the reference row.

machining_ref_search_pdf.prompt_note: Search only locally indexed user PDFs and retain each hit's source_id, hash and exact pdf_page/page_index citation. Snippets are bounded evidence; fetch or inspect the cited page before turning one into a controlled plan value.

make_drawing.prompt_note: Build geometry first, then start shop drawings with model_items=False and an explicit ledger-driven annotation plan. Returns drawing_doc_id + view map; refine, review_drawing, audit_drawing, then export_drawing.

make_fit_coupon.prompt_note: Needs measured dims on the interface first; returns a NEW doc_id to export with export_part for a real test-fit before the full print.

make_presentation.prompt_note: Load-bearing numbers must reference attached_results tool outputs — a bare numeral is a validation error; spec shape in cad_guide('deliverables').

make_report.prompt_note: Same spec envelope as make_presentation; format docx (default) or pdf. Provenance is enforced BEFORE any file is written.

make_standard_part.prompt_note: list_standard_parts first for family/size keys; makes the new doc CURRENT — save_part it before asm_add_component; the returned datum aids placement.

make_weldment_traveler.prompt_note: Controlled weld shop handoff (kind/template weldment_traveler): cut and joint lists, provenance-backed WPS values, fit-up/distortion controls, visual/NDT inspection, signoff; format docx or pdf.

make_work_instruction.prompt_note: Controlled machining routing (kind/template work_instruction): every machined operation needs setup datum/WCS, fixturing, machine/tool, provenance-backed process values, and in-process inspection; format docx or pdf.

make_workbook.prompt_note: Rows mix prose labels, provenance value cells and live formulas ('=SUM(B2:B5)') that recompute on open; spec in cad_guide('deliverables').

match_model.prompt_note: For a discrete branded product (MPN/brand) after checking catalog parts. Only exact/attach:true matches can auto-place; confirm ambiguous identities, or use a known CAD URL with fetch_cad_model.

match_part_number.prompt_note: First stop for a purchased MPN — strips vendor suffixes (-ND etc.) and runs fully offline; on matched=false fall through to match_model, never guess params.

measure.prompt_note: Colour-coded multi-element probe returning image + caption; for a pure text distance/angle reading without a render use measure_between.

measure_between.prompt_note: Each query must resolve to exactly ONE face/edge — narrow with pick/side or run query_geometry first; omit b_query for intrinsic area/length/radius.

measure_from_photo.prompt_note: Needs a photo_id from submit_part_photos first; px_a/px_b are FULL-RES pixel coords; low-tier reads still demand confirm_dimensions.

measure_part.prompt_note: Combined mass props over ALL bodies (per-body under mass.bodies[]); pass density_g_cm3 for non-steel; also sanity-checks the solid is closed/valid.

mfg_approval_inspect.prompt_note: Pass exactly one approval_id or proposal_id. A frozen approval read adds active/burned/revoked status; a proposal remains unapproved, and this read cannot create or validate either one.

mfg_approval_propose.prompt_note: Use only after the draft run has preflight evidence. The result is an UNAPPROVED proposal for a human seat, not authority; a human creates the binding and the arbiter alone validates it at start.

mfg_artifact_register.prompt_note: For NC/G-code, run cam_post then cam_audit first. This call only hashes immutable content under the command lease; it performs no device I/O, run creation, or authorization.

mfg_device_capability.prompt_note: Treat all nine capability truth levels literally; device presence never promotes transport to execute. Physical execute and safety_integration remain unadvertised before the qualified pilot.

mfg_device_describe.prompt_note: Read identity/fingerprint, transport, allowlist, capability and policy together before planning a lane. connected=true is not execute authority, and physical execute/safety_integration remain unadvertised.

mfg_device_list.prompt_note: Discovery before any manufacturing request: each candidate reports its allowlist decision, FreshValue lane state and capability ceiling. Physical endpoints are denied by default; a listed device grants no authority.

mfg_gate_report.prompt_note: Read the gate_report_ref returned by preflight or a start refusal. The result is seq-stamped Tier-0/two-stage evidence, but remains advisory until the arbiter revalidates a current human approval.

mfg_journal_query.prompt_note: Requires command-lane ownership and returns ordered records, head_seq and waiver_rates. Journal seq values are the sole durable ordering truth; never synthesize seq from telemetry time.

mfg_plan_check.prompt_note: Run only after mfg_plan_upsert, and again after geometry/manufacturing fixes; pass doc_id when geometry exists. not_evaluated is honest missing evidence, not a pass. Drawing release still requires audit_drawing separately.

mfg_plan_get.prompt_note: Read the stable ledger plan by run_id/plan_id. view='audit_spec' returns the exact {requirements:[...]} object to pass unchanged to audit_drawing; view='work_instructions' projects the same controlled route for the shop.

mfg_plan_render.prompt_note: Render an already-upserted plan as controlled json or md; validate first with mfg_plan_check and never treat the rendered artifact as a second editable source of manufacturing truth.

mfg_plan_upsert.prompt_note: Persist one stable plan id before modeling; update it with a monotonic revision instead of plan_v2 siblings. Numeric critical rows need provenance (and derived_from/derivation when derived), then mfg_plan_check must run.

mfg_preflight_run.prompt_note: Call after immutable artifact registration on a connected, identified device. It creates or refreshes a draft run and returns run_id plus Tier-0/two-stage gates; it cannot authorize start.

mfg_run_describe.prompt_note: Use a run_id from preflight/history to read state, artifact, gate, approval and initiator history. A held or discontinuous run is not resumable; author a new run with fresh inspection, preflight and approval.

mfg_run_list.prompt_note: Durable run history, optionally filtered by device/state; it is not current device telemetry. Use the returned run_id for a full run description rather than inferring approval or initiator from the state label.

mfg_telemetry_snapshot.prompt_note: The snapshot is a FreshValue envelope (v/time/seq/age/ttl/src/state/why), with gaps left unknown and raw rows separate. Never infer physical execute or safety_integration from connected/probed telemetry.

mission_start.prompt_note: Compiles but does not execute — then dag_run(run_id=<its run_id>) starts it (bare dag_run() reuses the same graph). Needs a deliverable manifest; you may write it yourself. Call it without `manifest` and the refusal hands you a fill-in template.

mission_status.prompt_note: Phase-level view (stage_log, open questions) from the run's ledger; use dag_status for raw topology. Fails if the run has no ledger.

motion_fea_handoff.prompt_note: One-call worst-frame stress check on an assembly link (needs mates). dry_run=True shows the loads before you pay for the FEA solve.
