motion_fea_handoff_sweep.prompt_note: motion_fea_handoff at several mechanism positions in one call; returns a per-position stress/reaction table plus the worst position. Use background=True beyond a few positions.

new_assembly.prompt_note: Components come from FILES: build parts, save_part each, then new_assembly → asm_add_component → asm_mate → solve_mates. An open assembly of that name is RESUMED with its components (reused, component_count); fresh=True makes a separate empty one.

new_part.prompt_note: Returns the new doc_id and makes it current — follow with add_features. ONE DESIGN IS ONE DOCUMENT: iterate on an existing part IN PLACE, never bump the name (holster_v2, bracket-rev4) — versions live in history (plm_timeline/plm_rollback), and a bumped name is resumed, not minted.

office_convert.prompt_note: LibreOffice-headless format bridge (docx/odt/pdf/pptx/odp/xlsx/ods/csv/html/txt). Writes beside the input unless out= is given. Requires LibreOffice on the machine — a converter_missing refusal means it is not installed, not that the file is bad. Conversion is one-way authoring: prefer editing the native format (office_edit_*) and converting LAST, since round-trips can drop format-specific features.

office_edit_csv.prompt_note: Full rewrite — you must send the ENTIRE dataset every call; rows is data rows only, pass header separately. office_read_csv first to preserve what you don't change.

office_edit_doc.prompt_note: Lossy soffice round-trip (.doc→.docx→.doc) with office_edit_docx ops in the middle — legacy .doc features may not survive. Prefer office_edit_docx whenever a .docx exists.

office_edit_docx.prompt_note: paragraph_index is 0-based over body paragraphs only (no table cells); text goes into the first run and the rest are blanked — per-run formatting in the paragraph is lost.

office_edit_pdf.prompt_note: Page indices in ops are 0-based and ops apply sequentially, so deletes shift later pages — delete in descending order. For text changes: extract, edit the docx, re-export to PDF.

office_edit_pptx.prompt_note: slide and shape_index are 0-based and shape_index counts ALL shapes on the slide, not just text frames; one invalid op aborts the whole batch before anything is saved.

office_edit_xlsx.prompt_note: Preserves existing formulas and .xlsm macros, but the openpyxl round-trip drops charts/images, and a newly written formula has no cached value until Excel recalculates it.

office_extract.prompt_note: Cheapest first look at any office file — dispatch by extension. Switch to the per-format office_read_* reader when you need structure (pptx notes, pdf page_range, single xlsx sheet).

office_read_csv.prompt_note: First row is always returned as header, never as data; the effective default returns at most 500 data rows. Pass limit=0 explicitly only when you intend to read every row.

office_read_doc.prompt_note: Needs soffice/libreoffice on PATH (reason:converter_missing otherwise) — headless-converts to .docx in a tmp dir, then reads exactly like office_read_docx.

office_read_docx.prompt_note: Body-level paragraphs + tables only (no headers, footers or text boxes). paragraph order here is exactly what office_edit_docx(paragraph_index) addresses.

office_read_pdf.prompt_note: page_range input is 1-based ("1-3,5") but the returned page.index is 0-based — mind the shift when feeding indices to office_edit_pdf.

office_read_pptx.prompt_note: text_runs skips empty text frames, so run position is NOT the shape_index office_edit_pptx expects — count all shapes on the slide when targeting an edit.

office_read_xlsx.prompt_note: Returns cached values (data_only=True) — a formula cell shows its last calculated value or None if never calculated; the formula text itself is not visible here.

optimize_print_orientation.prompt_note: Measured ranking (support, time, tip risk, bed fit). Pass strength_dir for loaded parts and preserve_faces for cosmetic or precision faces; slice_part(orientation='auto') uses the same scorer.

part_get.prompt_note: Fetch the full PartRecord after a part_search hit — summary rows omit the params/specs you need before part_place or cam_tool_import.

part_place.prompt_note: doc is the document dict (or its json.dumps), NEVER a doc id; omit doc for mechanical parts — they create their own document.

part_search.prompt_note: First stop for catalog/standard hardware by designation or category (e.g. MG90S, 608 bearing, M3 screw). Rows are compact — part_get for the full record.

part_source.prompt_note: Rank a plain-language product need and follow its candidate's artifact_plan (part_place / scrape_import / make_standard_part / find_model / fetch_cad_model). Confirm uncertain identities; do not re-search indefinitely.

parts_taxonomy.prompt_note: Browse here when the user names a category loosely; a node's effective facets are exactly the facet keys part_search(facets=...) accepts there.

piping_bom.prompt_note: Line list, pipe/fitting/flange quantities with masses, and shop spools broken at flanges and max_spool_length_mm; pass the routed piping (or a session network name) and doc_id to merge the BOM into the doc's piping_network study.

piping_cfd_handoff.prompt_note: Solve -> bore STEP -> LBM CFD in one call; use background=True on big grids. RANS accuracy needs a manual run_cfd_accurate + piping_verify_cfd.

piping_edit.prompt_note: Atomic draw/edit: add_run paths in mm auto-create elbows/tees; add_fitting inserts valves/orifices/custom K. Pass doc_id to persist, then re-solve.

piping_fitting_k.prompt_note: Deterministic K preview and Reynolds curve. Quote the returned method; custom fittings need a k_model, not an invented default.

piping_fitting_k_cfd.prompt_note: Shared GUI/agent CFD K pipeline: quick=2 Re points at 12 cells across. Use background=True; poll this tool with job_id, cancel=True to stop. apply=True + fitting_id writes params.k_model; doc_id saves the network. Only elbows generate bores; other fittings require a closed fluid-volume geometry.

piping_fluid.prompt_note: Pre-flight the fluid before piping_solve — same sourced values the solver uses; unknown names return ok:false with a hint, never invented numbers.

piping_internal_volume.prompt_note: Geometry bridge to CFD: import the STEP as a part, then run_cfd_flow. piping_cfd_handoff already does this whole chain.

piping_load.prompt_note: Restore a piping_network study persisted in a doc (doc_id, optional network name) into the session before re-solving or re-checking; a doc with several networks refuses and lists their names.

piping_operating_point.prompt_note: Pump-curve CSV (flow m3/h, head m) as text or path; omit system to derive the system curve from a piping doc + boundary.

piping_pump_drive.prompt_note: Reads the pump run's flow_m3h + pump_head_m from the network's last piping_solve (solve with pumps=[...] first; run_id when several pumps) and sizes its electric motor via pump_drive_size; doc_id saves it in the piping_network study.

piping_report.prompt_note: No-arg call re-reads the most recent piping_solve — cheapest K-factor breakdown; pass doc+boundary only for a fresh network.

piping_route.prompt_note: Orthogonal obstacle-avoiding route (mm) between start/end points; dir is the travel direction (start: nozzle outward normal, end: MINUS the end nozzle's outward normal); doc_id injects every solid body as an obstacle (ignore_bodies exempts the equipment you connect to). Elbows are added at each bend; no_route means widen the gap, lower clearance_mm or change grid_mm, never hand-draw through solids.

piping_solve.prompt_note: At least one fixed pressure/head node is required; node ids come from snapped run endpoints — read them from the result before writing boundary entries.

piping_spec_check.prompt_note: ASME B31.3 eq. 3a wall check per run plus B16.5 flange rating and support span; design_pressure_kpa is gauge, design_temp_c in °C. Cite t_required_mm/mawp_kpa/utilization per run; all_pass:false is a finding to fix (schedule, material, class), not a warning.

piping_verify_cfd.prompt_note: Verify node after piping_cfd_handoff (reuses its stored result with no args); compares dP budgets at tolerance_pct, not flow fields.

plm_add_remote.prompt_note: Register before plm_sync/plm_lock. folder/ssh/https work via the url string; chudware-cloud is config-only. Folder remotes take a bare repo path in url.

plm_checkpoint.prompt_note: Always pass a plain-language message — it is how the point is found later. item_id scopes the checkpoint to one item. On reason='locked', call plm_item_set(item_id=<id>, start_new_rev=True), then retry.

plm_compare.prompt_note: Get both commit ids from plm_history first. visual=True rebuilds both versions in the C++ engine and renders PNGs — slow, degrades gracefully without the engine.

plm_graph_brief.prompt_note: One-node dossier (identity, degree, edge kinds, neighbors) — the cheap orientation call before expanding anything in the project graph.

plm_graph_changes.prompt_note: Diffs the project graph against its last cached build — run after edits to see what your change actually touched.

plm_graph_configure.prompt_note: Get/set what the graph builder ingests (office content, linked projects); op='get' first — the build reads this config.

plm_graph_keyword.prompt_note: Tag graph nodes/paths with keywords so plm_graph_search and watch overlays can slice by topic; op='add' by default.

plm_graph_links.prompt_note: List/remove hand- or AI-authored overlay links; the add half is cad_graph_link — pair suggestions (plm_graph_suggest) with explicit links for relationships that matter.

plm_graph_neighbors.prompt_note: Ego graph around node_id within depth hops — widen depth only when depth=1 misses the dependency you are tracing.

plm_graph_search.prompt_note: Substring/kind/keyword search over the project graph — the entry point for finding a node_id before brief/neighbors.

plm_graph_suggest.prompt_note: Heuristic overlay-link suggestions; review before linking — suggestions are candidates, not facts.

plm_graph_watch.prompt_note: Manage the watch overlay (keywords/node ids of interest) so later graph diffs flag what you actually care about.

plm_history.prompt_note: Newest first; pass limit to cap tokens on long projects. Commit ids from here drive plm_compare and plm_restore.

plm_init.prompt_note: Vault-backed plm_* tools take the project root as path; omit it to use CHUDWARE_PROJECT_DIR/CHUDWARE_FS_ROOT through the shared outermost-marker resolver. plm_init is idempotent.

plm_item_add.prompt_note: Only for non-design files (specs, datasheets, sim folders): use plm_item_add(path=<project root>, file_path=<file relative to it>) or folder_path for a folder. .step+/.ecad+ design documents auto-track on save; never add them by hand — call plm_checkpoint.

plm_item_set.prompt_note: The only way to edit a released item again: start_new_rev=True opens a working rev. Calling with neither part_number nor start_new_rev errors out.

plm_link_repo.prompt_note: Links a repo by reference only — nothing is copied in; the version pin lands at release. Use plm_item_add when the sources should be versioned in the vault.

plm_live_join.prompt_note: Only for a plm-server remote registered with live_coedit — folder/ssh/https remotes use plm_lock instead. Pass item_id plus local_doc_id so the open document joins the session; the reply may return a REPLACEMENT local_doc_id when the server's authoritative snapshot supersedes local state. The bearer token comes from CHUDWARE_PLM_LIVE_TOKEN; never write it into a project file.

plm_live_leave.prompt_note: Idempotent — leaving when not joined is a successful no-op. When the LAST participant leaves, the server writes one vault checkpoint attributed to everyone who committed, so leave deliberately rather than abandoning the session.

plm_live_poll.prompt_note: Drains complete, in-order commit/snapshot events for a joined item. Apply nothing yourself — each event is already applied whole; poll only to observe sequence, participants, and connection state.

plm_live_presence.prompt_note: Best-effort cursor/selection sharing only; it never changes the document, revision, or history. Safe to skip entirely.

plm_live_propose.prompt_note: Rarely called directly: once an item is joined, ordinary document edits already travel this path and receive the one server-assigned order. Send a whole op batch (never a partial one) and read seq plus ops_response. A refusal is authoritative — fix the batch and re-send; never apply it locally instead.

plm_lock.prompt_note: Advisory, team-visible; reason='locked' means someone holds it — do not edit around it. Lock before editing a shared item, plm_unlock after.

plm_open.prompt_note: Identical to plm_init (one delegates to the other) — use either to open-or-create a vault; both are zero-config and idempotent.

plm_plan.prompt_note: list first to learn entity ids, then create/update/delete with data; update and delete need id. Entries version and restore with the project.

plm_release.prompt_note: On reason='preflight_failed' read problems, fix them, or re-call with confirm=true. Released items freeze — to edit again use plm_item_set(start_new_rev=True).

plm_restore.prompt_note: Non-destructive — the restore is itself a new entry and can be undone. Get commit ids from plm_history; item_id scopes the restore to one item.

plm_rollback.prompt_note: Undo for AI-authored docs only; for vault state use plm_restore. Get ids from plm_timeline first; '-1' targets the newest checkpoint. Silent — never asks the user.

plm_rollback_check.prompt_note: Non-destructive preflight for plm_rollback — same target syntax, changes nothing. Returns what a rollback WOULD discard (discarded_messages/turns), whether geometry moves (geometry_rollback), and whether the backing file was modified outside this session (file.externally_modified; null = unknown). Call it before any rollback the user did not explicitly confirm.

plm_save.prompt_note: Snapshot the whole project after an edit batch. Use plm_checkpoint for a named return point, plm_release to ship a revision.

plm_set_ai_mode.prompt_note: Per-project setting persisted in the vault. managed lets the copilot write checkpoints itself; assisted (default) only drafts and suggests.

plm_status.prompt_note: Cheap orientation call before release/sync: items with revision + lifecycle, which are dirty (unsaved), head, ai_mode, remotes, locks.

plm_sync.prompt_note: Needs a remote registered via plm_add_remote first. Same-item collisions are copied under a new name, never merged — check conflicts_copied in the result.

plm_timeline.prompt_note: AI-VC checkpoints for AI-authored documents — NOT the project vault timeline (that is plm_history). Empty doc_id lists every AI-VC chain.

plm_unlock.prompt_note: Releases only a lock you hold — always pair with plm_lock once the edit is saved so teammates are not blocked.

plm_where_used.prompt_note: Run before a release or new rev to see the blast radius; transitive=True walks the whole consumer chain. Unknown item_id returns invalid_item.

polymesh_cli.prompt_note: Independent Polyhedral-FEA CLI lane (check|mesh|solve|diag) on an exported STEP with explicit fix/load boxes in metres; the runbook's cross-check for the critical case, not a replacement for run_fea_static.

power_budget.prompt_note: Bookkeeping, not SPICE: feed board_path from ecad_to_3d's sidecar and power_profile_path from fw_power_profile, else it runs degraded (labelled).

preflight_ops.prompt_note: Dry-run on a shadow clone — never mutates the live doc; a 'fail' verdict is advisory and does NOT block add_features. Cheap insurance before big edits.

print_media_inventory.prompt_note: Read-only; call it the moment a USB/SD delivery is asked for, and again after publishing. Compare its printable rows with the complete job set; the printer shows no timestamps, so never pick 'current' by mtime. Pass inventory_token to publish_print_media.

project_into_sketch.prompt_note: Appends to an EXISTING sketch (convert_face_to_sketch creates one). 'front'/'top'/'right' mean datum planes, not faces — use a sid or side word for solid faces.

publish_print_media.prompt_note: The only way G-code goes onto printer media — never cp/fs_write it there. jobs = the COMPLETE project set of print_ready slice_part manifests; a job that is not print_ready goes on only when the user explicitly says to put it there anyway: pass that job's user_override=<their words> and report its failed checks — never refuse that instruction or hand-copy instead. media_idle=True only after the user confirms no printer is using the media. Default to raw files at drive root; layout='project' permits ONE top-level project folder, never nested delivery trees or CAD/review packets. Delete deprecated G-code, never archive it; keep only temporary rollback staging. Report returned filenames and unmanaged printables left; never call the media clean while they remain.

pump_drive_size.prompt_note: Electric motor for a pump: kind=hydraulic (flow_lpm + pressure_bar) or centrifugal (flow_m3h + head_m). Rounds shaft power x service_factor up the IEC kW or NEMA hp ladder; quote motor_rating, poles, frame and full_load_current_a. For a solved piping network use piping_pump_drive instead.

query_adjacency.prompt_note: Reach for it to reason about a shared edge — convex outside-corner vs concave pocket edge — which the flat per-face read-back never carries.

query_geometry.prompt_note: Plain-word phrases work for faces AND edges ('the vertical edges', 'the top face') — confirm a pick resolves before referencing it in a feature; zero or >1 match on a slot needing one → narrow with pick/near/count/index. Fully open-ended explore → describe_part + hover instead.

read_native_file.prompt_note: Read a saved .step+ tree (features with params/refs, components, mates, materials, appearances, meta) without opening it — use this, never unzip/jq. Narrow with sections=[...] / feature_ids / component_ids; embedded BREP and other long strings come back as '<N chars omitted>'. Read-only: to change the file, import_part it and edit the document.

recommend_fit.prompt_note: Function-to-fit-class step before fit_calc; pass the diameter in the same call to get the computed band and skip the follow-up fit_calc entirely.

recover_parts.prompt_note: After a server restart reloads the LAST dropped session's autosaves with FRESH doc_ids (re-map your handles); all=True reaches the full history. BOUNDED to the newest 8 docs; `skipped` counts what stayed on disk. Raise limit= only if the part you want is not among them, because reopening a big pile leaves nothing able to resolve 'the part'.

redo.prompt_note: Usually denied for agents (undo_denied) — roll the doc back with plm_timeline then plm_rollback instead; if it does run, render_part to confirm the restored state.

regen_diagnose.prompt_note: For a FAILED rebuild — pass the failed doc JSON (+ last-good reference_json for a drift check); record the verdict with regen_resolve. Needs a model provider.

regen_resolve.prompt_note: Second half of regen_diagnose: accept/edit/reject the fix card; 'edit' re-applies your edit_ops_json to the ORIGINAL broken document.

relocate_native_files.prompt_note: Metadata-only COPY via the native serializer, not a geometry operation. Supply plan_path to JSON containing entries (absolute path/destination, optional document name/component_names) and an absolute old-to-new path_map. Inspect first; never rename feature labels or rebuild/solve to organize files. Sources remain unchanged and destination overwrites are refused. Relative references, including unmapped dependencies, are rebased. The unique result JSON beside the plan records every native outcome; partial failure may mean some copies exist. Read it before retrying, and never treat report failure as proof that no native files were written.

render_animation.prompt_note: The moving deliverable — a .gif/.mp4 a review PLAYS, not a still: kind='turntable' orbits a part, 'explode' flies an assembly's components apart (factor), 'motion' films a SOLVED trajectory, 'fea' warps a solved vtu_path by field. A motion film takes exactly one drive: mate_id (+start/stop) sweeps a dimensional mate, steer={'components':[...],'axis':{'point':[..],'dir':[..]},'angle_deg':N} (+rear_steer) ramps a steer sweep 0->angle for an assembly with no drivable mate — same spec as steering_turning_radius — and poses=[{component:[16 numbers]},...] films an explicit frame list; collision samples are marked. save_path is a REQUIRED absolute .gif/.mp4 in the project; frames/fps set duration and frames_dir collects the PNG sequence for a multi-segment film. Needs ffmpeg; a single still is still render_part.

render_ascii.prompt_note: Experimental last resort for no-vision models — prefer describe_part / render_part; only its own p-handle callouts are addressable here, not sids.

render_board_ascii.prompt_note: Board mutations already append a compact auto-readback — read that first; use this uncapped full render as the final review before declaring a board done.

render_document.prompt_note: Previews a saved artifact (pptx/docx/xlsx/pdf/…); office formats need LibreOffice on PATH else converter_missing — the artifact itself is untouched.

render_part.prompt_note: Check numbers first; don't render after every mutation. One call = a 2x2 grid of the 4 most useful complementary shots (measured, SID-tagged, caption lists what each tile shows and faces no tile sees); target= the feature id to frame it; view= only for one specific single shot.

render_schematic_ascii.prompt_note: Keep its grid+index output — that is the cell contract apply_ascii_edits(kind='schematic') resolves edits against.

render_sim_ascii.prompt_note: Topological, not spatial — the read after ecad_simulate (or pass offline JSON); for cell-addressed sheet edits use render_schematic_ascii.

render_sketch.prompt_note: Renders the SOLID context + sketch health caption — there is no isolated flat view; the sketch entities themselves → sketch_preview_text.

render_sketch_ascii.prompt_note: add_features batches already append a compact auto-readback — read that first; pair this with sketch_health for the final verify loop.

render_study_setup.prompt_note: The fixture/load FIGURE an FEA report needs beside its stress plot: fixtures painted magenta, load faces violet, rest desaturated, plus ONE ARROW PER LOAD ENTRY (tip on that entry's face centroid, along its own force vector, scaled to its magnitude) and the resultant burned into a band at the bottom, so two cases on the same faces are different figures. fixtures/load are EXACTLY run_fea_static's dialect and are resolved by the same gates, so pass the identical arguments and draw this BEFORE the solve — a refusal here is the setup error the solver would have raised. Omit view to let the shot planner pick the camera that shows the most of those faces; save_path also writes the embeddable PNG.

render_views.prompt_note: Planner set of 7 complementary views (or views=[...] for a fixed drawing set) — heavier than render_part's 4-tile grid; only when four views leave a face unseen.

replan_request.prompt_note: Routing dry-run only — reports required approvers, changes nothing; apply with dag_replan once ruled on.

req_create.prompt_note: doc_id embeds the brief in the .step+, req_path writes a standalone .req.json; then add needs/requirements with req_update.

req_report.prompt_note: markdown (default) is the read-only diff-stable view; format='json' returns the raw aicad.req/1 object for programmatic reads.

req_status.prompt_note: Agents may NOT set user_confirmed or waived — verifier outcomes go to verified/failed with an evidence dict attached.

req_update.prompt_note: add_need first, then add_requirement with need_id + kind + verify_by — the verifier names are what req_verify_by_id will later run.

req_verify_by_id.prompt_note: Runs the requirement's verify_by verifiers and writes status+evidence back; confirm_dimensions/dfm_check/fit_report are skipped (unsupported in v1).

request_mfg_abort.prompt_note: REQUEST only: the daemon lane asks the arbiter to validate state/initiator, then the device adapter performs a controlled abort; approval authority remains the arbiter's. This is not an E-stop or safety-rated stop.

request_mfg_hold.prompt_note: REQUEST only: the daemon lane asks the arbiter first, then the device adapter performs feed_hold/controlled_stop/door_suspend; approval authority remains the arbiter's. This software hold is not an E-stop or safety function.

request_mfg_run_start.prompt_note: REQUEST only: the arbiter alone revalidates the current human approval, binding, fingerprint and gates before the daemon device adapter may start. Physical execute/safety_integration remain unadvertised and are refused.

request_part_photos.prompt_note: Only after standard-parts lookup fails to resolve the part; the user's files come back next turn via submit_part_photos.

request_quote.prompt_note: No configured API key (XOMETRY_API_KEY / JLCPCB_KEY) → ok=false without any network call. xometry takes a mechanical doc (auto-exports STEP), jlcpcb the Gerber bundle.

request_raise.prompt_note: Raise a worker request to manager/orchestrator/overseer instead of stalling on missing context, resources, or an escalation.

request_resolve.prompt_note: Managers: every raised request MUST be explicitly resolved (grant|deny|escalate) — silent expiry is impossible.

research_datasheet_fetch.prompt_note: The READ tool when the source is a PDF (local path or URL) — research_fetch_page is for HTML. Degrades to ok:false/no_pdf_tool when pdfminer.six is not installed.

research_eng_calc.prompt_note: Not an arithmetic tool (no add/sum). On an unknown-formula error, pick from the returned `known` catalogue instead of retrying spellings; list_calcs shows the schemas up front.

research_fetch_page.prompt_note: Read a specific HTML specs/datasheet source after the parts library cannot supply a needed dimension. Capture its citation and build; a model page's CAD file belongs in fetch_cad_model.

research_material_lookup.prompt_note: Lookup for a NAMED material, not a selector. For 'which alloy for this job' run research_web_search for candidates first, then this per alloy for the actual numbers.

research_standard_section.prompt_note: Bundled table is small: a handful of AISC W-shapes plus NPS 1-6 pipe (sch 40/80), imperial units. On not_found it lists the covered set — fall back to research_web_search.

research_thread_spec.prompt_note: Use before modeling or calling out any thread — designation in (M8x1.25, 1/4-20 UNC), computed minor diameters and tensile stress area out; never recall these from memory.

research_unit_convert.prompt_note: Only length/angle/count families (to mm/deg/count) — stress units like ksi are out of scope. A unit outside its family is rejected as bad_unit, never silently coerced.

research_web_search.prompt_note: Use for missing specs/datasheets or locating a specific CAD model URL after checking the library. For a found CAD page/file, use fetch_cad_model(url), not research_fetch_page as geometry. Without TAVILY_API_KEY the DuckDuckGo fallback is labeled confidence:limited.

resolve_process.prompt_note: Decide once, then bind the choice with set_process. Pass run_id so the clarification is ledgered and a DAG gate never re-asks.

reveng_add_images.prompt_note: Supply image paths or a directory. Each image must decode; failed sources return ok:false with full failed paths while valid images are retained.

reveng_add_video.prompt_note: Alternative to reveng_add_images for an orbit video — extracts blur-culled stills synchronously; drop max_frames on long clips.

reveng_attach_result.prompt_note: Final step: makes the result placeable via part_place under part_ref. Run after reveng_build_parametric (or at least a mesh) exists.

reveng_build_parametric.prompt_note: Run after reveng_fit_primitives (fits feed the hints). Single-photo sessions are refused unless strategy='override_approximate'; score with describe_reveng_result.

reveng_cancel_splat.prompt_note: Stops the owned Gaussian process tree while retaining the last valid preview; cancellation is not completion of the reconstruction.

reveng_crop_splat.prompt_note: Stop training first. Bounds are [xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax] in reconstruction units, not calibrated CAD millimetres; null restores the original.

reveng_finish_splat.prompt_note: Ends live acquisition by requesting a full-quality pass over accepted frames. Read reveng_splat_status for progress and the resulting preview.

reveng_fit_primitives.prompt_note: Needs a mesh first (reveng_reconstruct / reveng_single_photo / import_scan_mesh) and open3d provisioned; persists fits.json for reveng_build_parametric.

reveng_gate_status.prompt_note: Poll a mission by session_id; a non-null `gate` means the run is suspended — answer it with reveng_resolve_gate, never by relaunching.

reveng_ingest_datasheet.prompt_note: Datasheet lane; needs docling provisioned (backend_not_provisioned otherwise). Extracted tables surface as dim candidates in list_reveng_dims.

reveng_make_part_from_library.prompt_note: One-call orchestrator for an un-modeled library part. On model_present=false with pending_dims, confirm the fit-critical dims — re-calling never forces them.

reveng_print_scale_mat.prompt_note: Print before capture when no known dimension exists — the aruco_mat solver in reveng_set_scale defaults to exactly this mat's marker spec.

reveng_reconstruct.prompt_note: Async: returns run_id immediately. Add images first, then poll get_reveng_session / reveng_gate_status — the run PAUSES at the scale-confirm gate.

reveng_research_source.prompt_note: No-photo lane: needs part_number, query, or url (one required); offline returns honest ok:false. reveng_start_session(research=...) does this in one step.

reveng_resolve_gate.prompt_note: decision has no default — pass 'approve' or 'reject' explicitly. Reject stops the run but leaves it resumable from the same checkpoint.

reveng_set_scale.prompt_note: aruco_mat needs a reconstruction + printed mat; two_point needs registered-image pixels; known_dim takes your ratio with a provenance source. All leave confirmed=false.

reveng_single_photo.prompt_note: Preview tier when only one photo exists — uses the first image in images/ and force-tags the session approximate, so build_parametric will refuse without the override.

reveng_splat_status.prompt_note: Nonblocking durable job status and latest immutable Gaussian preview. A preview during training is not a finished full-quality result.

reveng_start_session.prompt_note: First call of any RE flow; pass research= (MPN/query/URL) to auto-populate the datasheet lane or part_ref to seed photos/datasheet from the parts hub.

reveng_start_splat.prompt_note: Starts local Gaussian reconstruction without CAD scale or mesh gates. Use live=true for arriving accepted images; object mode needs an explicit reconstruction-unit crop, not automatic segmentation.

reveng_status.prompt_note: Call first — probes backends (COLMAP etc.) before promising a reconstruction; pure and offline-safe, with fix-it banners for what's missing.

reverse_engineer.prompt_note: Long rebuild+verify pipeline. Afterwards read rejected/candidates/unexplained, fix by hand, re-prove with compare_parts; hints come from reveng_fit_primitives.

reverse_engineer_product.prompt_note: The hand-off when match_model misses — needs part_id or url; harvests page media + datasheets and opens the GUI ReverseEng tab for a human-in-the-loop session.

review_drawing.prompt_note: Inspect attached pixels plus sheet-mm JSON and clear layout/title/material warnings after the last mutation. layout_clean is necessary, not release: follow with audit_drawing against the ledger spec.

run_cfd_accurate.prompt_note: OpenFOAM external-aero RANS; the tool capability-checks first and returns ok:false, skipped:true when unavailable. Always returns job_id when started; poll get_job. Inputs are velocity m/s, aoa degrees, fluid air|water. Start preset='coarse', then refine; only quote Cd/Cl when converged is true.

run_cfd_flow.prompt_note: Built-in directional LBM: velocity is m/s, aoa degrees, fluid is air|water; freestream +X and lift +Z. Check V² force scaling/dynamic pressure, but absolute Cd is uncalibrated. Require converged=true and min_feature_voxels>=~8, then refine cells; use run_cfd_accurate for absolute coefficients. background=True for cells>=120.

run_fea_adaptive.prompt_note: Adaptive remesh-and-resolve for a decision-driving peak stress; use run_fea_static for an initial screen, then this when the peak is mesh-sensitive. Its relative indicator is not a stress-error bound; background=True returns job_id for get_job.

run_fea_buckling.prompt_note: Engine linear buckling on the real CAD tet10 mesh, size_mm=8 by default. Use the static fixtures/load/material dialect: face forces in N or pressures in MPa, including multiple loads. Read modes[].load_factor/participation, critical_load_factor, critical_load_n, mesh_quality and provenance.solver='engine'. A factor below 1 predicts buckling below the reference load. max_load_factor (default10000) is the search ceiling; no mode below it is refused, not a PASS or infinite strength. Refine size_mm for convergence; vtu_path exports mode shapes. Linear elastic instability is not nonlinear collapse strength.

run_fea_contact.prompt_note: REAL frictionless unilateral contact on the document's own meshed bodies: surface pairs facing across <=max_gap_mm carry compression only, solved by an active-set loop. Same fixtures/load dialect as run_fea_static, plus max_gap_mm just above the measured clearance. Read contact.active_pairs (0 = nothing touched), contact.converged, contact.pairs[].contact_force_n / max_contact_pressure_mpa, and reactions.equilibrium_error_pct. No friction, no large sliding, no preload — apply a clamp load as a face load instead. A load that pulls the parts apart is refused as a mechanism. Model press fits as bonded and running clearances as contact in the same study with interfaces={"bonded":[[1,2]],"contact":[[2,3]],"default":"free"} (one-based STEP solid ordinals or body names; explicit pairs override the default, which is contact on contact runs and free on ordinary static runs). bond_gap_mm can constrain the bonded search when interfaces is supplied; otherwise bonded pairs use their measured gap within max_gap_mm. For active-set chatter, tune the positive finite penalty_scale (default 1.0) and max_iterations (default 25), then check convergence and penetration. Read contact.interfaces.bonded/contact pair counts and area_mm2, unmatched declared pairs, and the echoed contact.penalty_scale/max_iterations. For mixed bodies pass material={"per_body":{"1":"steel","2":{"E_mpa":110000,"nu":0.34,"yield_mpa":125}},"default":"steel"} (one-based STEP solid ordinals); each body's own yield governs its FoS. When mean_contact_pressure_mpa comes back well above yield the ELASTIC answer is the artefact, not the part: re-run with plasticity={"hardening_mpa": 1200} so the seat yields and the patch spreads (the active-set loop runs inside each load increment), then quote the plastic contact_area_mm2 / mean pressure and the plasticity block. min_size_mm=<mm> lowers the element-size band floor when the run is refused for needing an element smaller than that floor to resolve a feature away from the interface; it costs elements and memory, so pair it with a coarse mesh_size_mm.

run_fea_convergence.prompt_note: Same static study at 2+ explicit mesh sizes (sizes_mm or fineness ladder); the table with delta_pct_vs_prev is the convergence evidence a release needs. Never cite one mesh. Pass vtu_dir=/abs/dir to get one .vtu per leg: the reply's released_leg then names the finest solved leg's field, which sim_evidence_packet hashes — without it the ladder has no field and needs a fourth solve. min_size_mm=<mm> lowers the element-size band floor for EVERY leg when a leg is refused for needing an element smaller than that floor to resolve a feature; it costs elements and memory, so keep the ladder's sizes coarse.

run_fea_fatigue.prompt_note: Runs real static FEA then S-N postprocessing. Needs the same mounted faces and non-zero N/MPa loads as run_fea_static plus material ultimate_mpa and endurance_mpa. State load_type/load_ratio, surface, reliability and theory; regime='infinite' means >1e6-cycle runout, not immortal. Refine the static mesh.

run_fea_frequency_response.prompt_note: Base-excited modal superposition. fixtures must represent the mount; excitation_dir is a unit direction, base_accel_g is g, damping zeta is assumed, and material density drives Hz. Response peaks should align with returned modal Hz. PSD breakpoints are g²/Hz; no PSD means random.ok=false and no vibration_spec means verdict=null. Output is acceleration only, not stress/deflection.

run_fea_modal.prompt_note: Material density drives Hz. fixtures=[] is a legitimate free-free solve: expect six near-zero rigid-body modes before elastic modes; otherwise fix it exactly as mounted. Compare the first elastic mode to a justified beam/order anchor and across mesh_fineness presets; properties come from material=, never set_material.

run_fea_static.prompt_note: Real-part linear static FEA. Confirm face queries first. fixtures must react a non-zero load: force vectors/magnitude are N, pressure is MPa; zero loads are refused and there is no gravity/self-weight term. An explicit material dict needs E_mpa, nu, and yield_mpa; named registry materials resolve them. For mixed bodies use material={"per_body":{"1":"steel","2":{"E_mpa":110000,"nu":0.34,"yield_mpa":125}},"default":"steel"} (one-based STEP solid ordinals, default optional if every body is assigned). set_material is appearance only. Repeat at a finer mesh and compare governing stress/deflection (<10% change) before PASS. mesh_size_mm=<mm> is the exact element size (mutually exclusive with mesh_fineness) — use it with vtu_path to re-solve one run_fea_convergence leg on its own mesh. min_size_mm=<mm> lowers the element-size band floor when a run is refused for needing an element smaller than that floor to resolve a feature; it costs elements and memory, so pair it with a coarse mesh_size_mm. plasticity={"hardening_mpa": 1200} switches the material to small-strain J2 (yield_mpa defaults to the material's own; hardening_mpa is a TANGENT MODULUS in MPa, 0 = perfectly plastic): use it when an elastic peak sits well above yield in a small region, because a linear-elastic solve cannot redistribute and reports a stress the material could never carry. Past the part's limit load it REFUSES as a collapse mechanism naming the load fraction carried; over 5 % plastic strain it warns (small strain, no mesh update). Not accepted by modal/buckling/thermal/fatigue or adaptive runs.

run_fea_thermal.prompt_note: Steady and transient use the real part tet mesh in the engine. hot_faces/cold_faces entries need {face,temperature °C}; loads support flux_w_m2 or h_w_m2k/t_amb_c. Steady requires a fixed-temperature or convection datum and non-zero thermal excitation, returns temperature extrema, flux_max_w_m2, mesh_quality/provenance, and supports vtu_path. Steady needs conductivity_w_mk/k_w_mk in W/(m·K). transient={t_end_s,dt_s,...} additionally supports schedules; flux-only heat-up is valid and needs conductivity, density_g_cm3, and cp_j_kgk/specific_heat_j_kgk in J/(kg·K).

run_pipe_flow.prompt_note: Native D3Q19 internal flow through a fluid-volume solid (pipe bore, e.g. piping + run_id derives it); inlet/outlet normals point INTO the domain. Quote dp_pa only with converged:true and read caveats when physical Re is under-resolved; compare against darcy_estimate_pa and re-run at a higher cells_across (default 20) before trusting a fitting dP. background=True returns job_id for get_job.

run_shell.prompt_note: Use for builds/tests/scripts; prefer fs_read/fs_grep/fs_glob/fs_write for plain file work. Stateless per call — pass cwd each time; pipe noisy output through head; check exit_code/timed_out.

run_topology_optimization.prompt_note: Mutating (writes study, jobs, artifacts). Query topology_capabilities first, then run the same persisted UI study: run_topology_optimization(study=..., doc_id=..., background=True). Poll with get_job/wait_job; stop with sim_cancel. Report computation, convergence and feasibility separately — a finished run is not a converged or feasible one. Inspect the density fields, thresholded surface, actual-domain reanalysis and manufacturing checks; the source CAD stays editable. For printing set print_process and build_plate, read DFAM, then pass print_handoff slice_part arguments with the user's printer. Geometry/DFAM alone are not print-ready: slice_part must validate the G-code.

save_part.prompt_note: Native editable Chudware document only (.step+ ZIP); it is NOT ISO STEP and a machine shop cannot treat it as .step. Save it for project history, and for external manufacturing also call export_part(fmt='step', path='...step').

scrape_enqueue.prompt_note: Returns immediately — the download runs in the background; poll scrape_queue_status, then import_artifact on done. Site must be logged in (vendor_login) first.

scrape_queue_status.prompt_note: The only way to follow a scrape job — poll this instead of re-enqueueing; artifact_path (input to import_artifact) exists only on status=done.

set_active_drawing_sheet.prompt_note: Select the destination sheet_id before adding views/tables/annotations; confirm with list_drawing_sheets and re-review the changed sheet.

set_config_override.prompt_note: Edits one param in ONE config (base untouched); vector params take a list (transform translate:[x,y,z]); clear=True removes the override.

set_config_suppression.prompt_note: Per-variant feature on/off without forking the tree; activate_configuration + render_part to confirm the variant looks right.

set_material.prompt_note: set_material(material='A36 steel'|'4140'|'6061-T6', body='b1'|None, doc_id=...) stores the registry material key AND matching appearance. An explicit {'color':[r,g,b],...} is appearance-only. There is no ops=[...] form. Mass/FEA still take their own material=/density input so each analysis case is explicit; run_cfd_flow takes fluid= and has no material argument.

set_process.prompt_note: Call once the process is known (FDM default) — its clearance/wall/thread numbers drive later fit-budgeted dims and dfm_check.

set_titleblock.prompt_note: Fill title/drawn_by/date/material/finish/scale/rev/sheet/part_number/company; review material must match the source and audit_drawing decides release completeness.

set_view.prompt_note: Use review_drawing sheet mm to fix layout; x/y/scale move or resize, while show_hidden/orientation change the projection. Re-review and re-audit after.

show_in_app.prompt_note: Daemon mode: the open app already mirrors every part live (reply live:true); it cannot switch the user's active tab. Legacy engine: writes the handoff file.

sim_cancel.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run. Really terminates the solver process, not a flag flip; sim_status then reports cancelled. The last partial snapshot survives, so sim_results(partial=True) may still have something.

sim_evidence_packet.prompt_note: Write the case folder (inputs/result/provenance/convergence/checklist) for a finished study; unsatisfied_checklist names what still needs a hand calc or judgement. A re-run into the same folder ARCHIVES the previous packet (archived_to) instead of overwriting it; overwrite=True is the only way to replace.

sim_jobs.prompt_note: Lists recent background solves with their state — use it to recover a job_id from an earlier turn before assuming a solve was lost.

sim_results.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run, after sim_status says done. partial=True returns whatever converged so far, clearly labelled — never quote a partial as a converged answer. partial=False on an unfinished job is refused rather than returning half a result.

sim_run.prompt_note: Cancellable process job for analysis='fea_static' or 'fea_modal' ONLY. Static needs fixtures plus a non-zero loads list; modal takes the fixtures argument but fixtures=[] intentionally requests free-free modes and takes no loads. Poll sim_status, then sim_results; an unavailable/failed backend never becomes PASS.

sim_status.prompt_note: job_id from sim_run. Reports queued/running/done/failed/cancelled and is reconciled against the OS — it never says running for a dead worker. Poll this before sim_results; call sim_jobs() if you lost the id.

simulate_motion.prompt_note: Kinematic sweep of one dimensional mate (mate_id/start/stop) or several at once (drivers=[{mate_id,start,stop}]). Angle ranges are degrees, distance ranges mm, steps>=2. fixtures/loads do not apply. check_interference samples each step, so refine steps near first contact. dynamics={} adds inverse-dynamics reactions but not contact dynamics.

sketch3d_add_constraints.prompt_note: Point handles: e3.p1/e3.p2/e3.pm, spline e3.pK, external vertex xN. Use tangent/equal/midpoint/collinear/concentric/coradial and plane-based on_plane/parallel_plane/normal_plane/symmetric; dimensions drive size. Avoid blanket fix pins; re-check check_sketch3d.

sketch3d_add_curves.prompt_note: Arcs are THREE-POINT [start,mid,end]; endpoints within 1e-4 mm chain into wires automatically. Simple routes → sketch3d_path_from_points instead.

sketch3d_as_sweep_guide.prompt_note: Returns the ready-to-paste sweep ref (path vs guides[] entry); a guide must be a DIFFERENT feature than the path, one guide per sweep.

sketch3d_clear.prompt_note: Wipes entities but keeps the feature id, so downstream sweep refs survive (they fail until the sketch has a wire again).

sketch3d_get.prompt_note: Reads authored constraints + SOLVED entity coordinates (what the GUI shows) + health; use before referencing a wire in a sweep.

sketch3d_list.prompt_note: All sketch3d features with wire/status/length summary — persistent doc features that save with the part.

sketch3d_new.prompt_note: Needs a current part (new_part first); returns the feature id every other sketch3d_* tool takes — populate via sketch3d_add_curves.

sketch3d_path_from_points.prompt_note: One-call route through world points: polyline = crisp bends, spline = smooth; close=True for a closed sweep path. Then sketch3d_pipe.

sketch3d_pipe.prompt_note: 'Run a 12 mm tube along this path' in one call — pass diameter_mm XOR profile_sketch; a zero-volume error names the pierce gap to fix.

sketch3d_preview.prompt_note: Text-only 'see the path' (solved coords, wire refs, health) — the headless check before sweeping; 2D sketches → sketch_preview_text.

sketch3d_ref_vertex.prompt_note: Mints a model-vertex point handle ('x1') usable in sketch3d_add_constraints refs; it tracks the vertex across rebuilds and warns if it goes stale.

sketch3d_sample_at.prompt_note: Point + tangent at arc-length fraction t∈[0,1] of the SOLVED path — for placing profile planes or datums along a route.

sketch3d_section_at.prompt_note: ENGINE LIMIT: the cut is always at the world ORIGIN — t only picks the plane orientation from the tangent; the on-path point → sketch3d_sample_at.

sketch_auto_constrain.prompt_note: Auto-runs after sketch edits (sketch.auto_coincident, default ON) — call explicitly only to preview (apply=False) or re-stitch with a looser tol_mm.

sketch_fully_define.prompt_note: After explicit design-intent relations/critical dimensions, define residual DOF without fix pins. anchor='origin'|'none'; entities optionally limits scope. Inspect exact added counts and remaining DOF; check_sketch must not be pinned_only.

sketch_health.prompt_note: Apply relations then driving dimensions; sketch_fully_define handles residual freedom. Require dof 0 and not pinned_only, not merely status='full'. Read findings for pins, missing driving dimensions and origin/model references.

sketch_preview_text.prompt_note: No-vision full text of a 2D sketch (entities/constraints/regions/DOF) — the readable alternative to render_sketch; 3D → sketch3d_preview.

slice_part.prompt_note: The only way to make G-code: never download a slicer or hand-write .ini keys. Run dfm_check and fix fails first; report print_ready and gcode_check issues honestly. copies= repeats a part; parts=[{doc_id|path, copies}] puts several parts on one plate; complete_individual_objects=True prints them one at a time (clearance-spaced, height-ordered; refusals name the objects that break it).

slicer_status.prompt_note: If no slicer is installed, give the user the returned install command (Linux: per-user flatpak) instead of improvising one.

solve_mates.prompt_note: Assembly docs only ('not an assembly' on a part); asm_mate already solves by default — call after bulk edits, then list_world_bodies.

spec_sheet_match.prompt_note: Long-tail lane after match_part_number/match_model fail; run list_spec_templates first — a missing required dim returns matched=false and builds nothing. LLM call, slow.

stackup_analyze.prompt_note: tol is the ± HALF-tolerance and direction ±1 the chain sign; invented tolerances MUST set assumed=True so they surface in assumed_dims.

stage_set.prompt_note: Only when the inferred stage is actually wrong; needs an existing run ledger (run_id) and a replay-visible real reason.

start_capture_session.prompt_note: One session per port — a duplicate call fails and returns the live upload_url. scale_marker_mm is only recorded; real scale comes via reveng_set_scale.

steering_turning_radius.prompt_note: Turning radius from the posed wheel axle lines (ft and m), with the closed-form Ackermann numbers beside it. An assembly whose uprights are posed by concentric/coincident kingpin mates has NO mate to drive: pass steer={components:[...], axis:{point,dir} or mate_id, angle_deg or angles_deg:[...]} (plus rear_steer for 4WS) and it rotates them on a detached clone. Pass wheelbase_mm/track_mm when the axle heuristic refuses; check_interference=True names the first angle that clashes.

stop_capture_session.prompt_note: Needs MESHROOM_BIN or COLMAP_BIN set; takes minutes. Mesh is in reconstruction units, not mm — reveng_set_scale first, then reverse_engineer(source=mesh_path).

struct_analyze.prompt_note: struct_check already runs this same analysis plus D/C ratios — use struct_analyze only when you want raw member forces, no pass/fail.

struct_check.prompt_note: The go/no-go member check (AISC LRFD steel / NDS ASD wood); dc_ratio<=1 passes. Input is an aicad.structure/1 JSON file on disk.

struct_estimate.prompt_note: Rate-table budget figures, not vendor prices (those are bom_price — don't mix). Same structure doc as struct_check.

submit_bug_report.prompt_note: Only for OUR bugs (a schema-conformant call still fails, a crash, an unknown method) — never for ordinary retry-and-fix errors.

submit_part_photos.prompt_note: photos= registers files (then measure_from_photo); claims= submits dims you read. Close returned open_demands via confirm_dimensions.

suggest_dimension_scheme.prompt_note: Dimension plan for an existing sketch; size mating bores with fit_calc FIRST (they come back needs_user_confirm). process drives the IT grade.

suggest_drawing_dimension_scheme.prompt_note: Plan explicit shop-drawing coverage from doc_id + process; it proposes a scheme but never supplies provenance or places annotations, so reconcile every row with the ledger before add_dimension/add_hole_callout.

sweep_envelope.prompt_note: Drive a mate through its range and return the union bbox the listed components sweep; fuse=True also builds the swept solid. No dimensional mate (steering uprights on concentric kingpin mates)? Pass steer={components,axis|mate_id,angle_deg} instead and it sweeps 0..lock. This is the folded/deployed envelope evidence, not a clash check.

tap_drill.prompt_note: Quick drill size for a thread string; feeds_speeds(thread=...) returns the same value alongside cutting data.

task_list.prompt_note: Publish the FULL list every call (omitted items disappear from the panel) — same order, updated statuses, after each step.

topology_capabilities.prompt_note: Read-only. Call FIRST to learn supported topology methods, physics, constraints, limits and print_processes before configuring a study; never assume an unlisted method or constraint. For printing choose a preset and a build_plate bed face.

undo.prompt_note: Usually denied for agents (undo_denied) — roll the doc back with plm_timeline then plm_rollback instead; if it does run, render_part to confirm the rolled-back state.

vendor_login.prompt_note: HEADED browser that blocks up to 300s while the HUMAN logs in — tell the user before calling and never retry-loop it; check vendor_status afterwards.

vendor_part_register.prompt_note: Registers a completed scrape's price/availability so bom_price can resolve that supplier + part number — import_artifact handles the geometry, this handles the money. The price is a SCRAPED figure stamped with provenance and a fetch timestamp, never a vendor quote; an ambiguous display price (a range, 'per pack of N') leaves unit_price null and returns price_unparsed rather than guessing — pass unit_price= explicitly to resolve it.

vendor_status.prompt_note: Fast local read (no network) of adapter keys + login state — check this before scrape_enqueue to pick an already-logged-in site.

vendors_health.prompt_note: Live network canary per adapter (blank sweeps all registered sites) — slow; prefer vendor_status for a quick answer. needs_human_login → run vendor_login(site).

verify_battery.prompt_note: Deterministic checks for THIS doc; the default set includes feature_attachment (floating / overhanging / edge-touching features, each with its close-up call) and solid health. PASS covers only keys in scores; drawings, fits, loads, tolerances and manufacturability need their own checks.

verify_gcode.prompt_note: Run on any G-code before it goes to a printer (slice_part already does); floating_extrusion fails mean mid-air plastic — reorient, enable supports, or redesign, never ship it.

verify_packet.prompt_note: Read a packet folder back and check its files describe one run (same input hash, same engine build, result.json matching the hash convergence.md cites, reduction fields present). Run it before citing a packet; ok:false means do not cite it.

vessel_size.prompt_note: ASME VIII-1 UG-27 shell + UG-32 head thickness from inner_diameter_mm and tan_tan_length_mm or volume_m3; design_pressure_kpa gauge, temps °C, corrosion allowance included. Quote t_nominal_mm, mawp_kpa and hydrotest_kpa from the result; doc_id+name persists a vessel study. Model the vessel afterwards with the returned thicknesses.

wait_job.prompt_note: Block on a get_job/sim job_id until it finishes (timeout_s ≤ 900, default 120) instead of sleep/ps loops or repeated get_job polls. still_running:true means call it again; waiting never cancels the job (sim_cancel does). Call it directly, never inside eval: the cell timeout counts the wait and can expire before the job finishes. Retrieve its result with get_job, then use a short eval.

wall_thickness.prompt_note: Headline is min_thickness_mm vs your process floor (~1 mm injection, ~0.8 mm FDM); null means an open/sheet body — confirm a solid with measure_part.

workspace_doc_events.prompt_note: Incremental per-doc event stream — pass the count of events you already have as since_seq.

workspace_status.prompt_note: One-call orient snapshot: project dir and open docs. Omit run_id in a chat turn. Call it before you touch docs you did not create.
